chrispedregal.en: AI is muscles; software must be bones—structure and context that make AI useful.
chrispedregal.zh: AI 是肌肉，软件必须是骨骼——提供结构与上下文，让 AI 真正有用。

chrispedregal.en: Pre-generating content like meeting briefs is key for timely assistance; cost is not the primary concern.
chrispedregal.zh: 预生成会议简报等内容是及时辅助的关键；成本并非首要考量。

chrispedregal.en: Users want to bring their own agent into the product, not use the product's UI.
chrispedregal.zh: 用户想把自己的智能体带进产品，而不是使用产品自带的界面。

chrispedregal.en: AI should augment humans, not replace them; human development and judgment remain primary.
chrispedregal.zh: AI 应增强人类而非取代人类；人的成长与判断力始终是第一位。

chrispedregal.en: Context and accountability are uniquely human strengths that AI struggles with; don't outsource judgment.
chrispedregal.zh: 上下文与担责是 AI 难以企及的人类独有优势；不要把判断外包给 AI。

satya.en: AI is the future of the firm: every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine and compound token capital, not just adopt a technology.
satya.zh: AI 不是一项技术，而是企业的未来：每家企业都要建自己的爬山机器、积累 token 资本，而不只是采用技术。

satya.en: The platform promise is a frontier ecosystem, not a frontier model: private evals and firm-owned learning loops let every company operate at the frontier.
satya.zh: 平台承诺是前沿生态而非前沿模型：私有评测与企业自有的学习闭环，让每家公司都能在前沿运作。

satya.en: Scaling laws work, but alignment and interpretability lag; treat powerful models as insider threats and build containment and assurance outside the model.
satya.zh: 缩放定律有效，但对齐与可解释性滞后；应把强大模型当作内部威胁，在模型之外构建遏制与保障层。

satya.en: Superintelligence is a better term than AGI; being six months behind the frontier is a smart strategy, and multiple models will coexist.
satya.zh: 超级智能比 AGI 更贴切；落后前沿六个月是明智策略，未来不会只有一个模型通吃。

satya.en: When code generation becomes cheap, verification is the hard part; firms must own context and harness, and there will be as many frontier models as firms.
satya.zh: 代码生成变便宜后，验证才是难点；企业必须掌控上下文与 harness，前沿模型将多到与公司数量相当。

laurentan.en: Trust is the bottleneck, not raw capability: agents need verification skills, a feature map, and a pristine codebase to act correctly without supervision.
laurentan.zh: 瓶颈是信任而非能力：智能体需要验证技能、功能地图和干净的代码库，才能无需监督地做对事。

laurentan.en: The engineer's job shifts from writing code to building the environment: skills, constraints, lints, and type systems that make the easy path correct.
laurentan.zh: 工程师的工作从写代码转向搭建环境：技能、约束、lint 和类型系统，让“容易的路”默认就是正确的路。

laurentan.en: Trust is built incrementally along a ladder: read-only first, then action-taking, then owning a whole job; you cannot jump from one agent to a thousand.
laurentan.zh: 信任要沿阶梯逐步建立：先只读，再动手，最后接管整份工作；无法从 1 个智能体直接跳到 1000 个。

laurentan.en: Hard enforcement via CI, lints, and architecture beats soft rules; auto-merging agent PRs and reviewing after landing becomes viable with strong verification.
laurentan.zh: 用 CI、lint 和架构做硬性约束胜过软规则；有了强验证，智能体 PR 自动合并、落地后再审查变得可行。

laurentan.en: As execution becomes abundant, the bottleneck shifts to intent specification, vision, and taste; agents become coworkers with identities and always-on proactivity.
laurentan.zh: 当执行变得充裕，瓶颈转向意图表达、愿景与品味；智能体成为有身份、持续主动的 AI 同事。

evanspiegel.en: Early on, he stresses learning rate, many ideas, and culture; turning down Facebook's $3B validated product belief over short-term money.
evanspiegel.zh: 早期他强调学习速率、多产想法与文化建设；拒绝 Facebook 30 亿美元收购，说明他更看重对产品的信念而非短期套现。

evanspiegel.en: By 2026 he frames distribution and ecosystems, not software, as the real moat; flat design teams and hardware make copying hard.
evanspiegel.zh: 到 2026 年，他把分发与生态而非软件视为真正护城河；扁平设计团队与硬件让对手难以复制。

evanspiegel.en: He increasingly ties Snap's mission to AR glasses and spatial computing, aiming to make computing more human and less isolating.
evanspiegel.zh: 他越来越把 Snap 的使命系于 AR 眼镜与空间计算，目标是让计算更人性化、更少隔离感。

evanspiegel.en: On AI he turns optimistic against doomerism: AI writes most new code, yet he doubts existential risk and trusts measured regulation over bans.
evanspiegel.zh: 在 AI 上他转向乐观、反对末日论：AI 已写大部分新代码，但他怀疑生存风险，主张审慎监管而非禁令。

evanspiegel.en: A constant thread: ephemerality, privacy, and close-friend communication as healthier social design, now extended to safety and well-being.
evanspiegel.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：阅后即焚、隐私与密友沟通是更健康的社交设计，如今延伸到安全与福祉。

dylanpatel.en: Early 2026: semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV, is the binding constraint on Scaling; compute costs and memory bandwidth shape model economics.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年初：他认为 Scaling（规模扩张）的最大瓶颈是半导体供应链，尤其是 EUV；算力成本与内存带宽决定模型经济性。

dylanpatel.en: Mid-2026: inference becomes a huge market; hardware-software co-design and memory bandwidth drive gains, with most progress coming from the model layer.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年中：推理将成为巨大市场；软硬件协同设计与内存带宽驱动性能提升，而过去三年大部分增益来自模型层而非硬件。

dylanpatel.en: By mid-2026 he stresses reasoning models and agentic workflows driving multi-year memory and CPU shortages, with token efficiency making top models cheaper.
dylanpatel.zh: 到 2026 年中，他强调推理模型与智能体式工作流造成内存和 CPU 的多年短缺，并指出因 token 效率，用最强模型反而更便宜。

dylanpatel.en: Late 2026: AI spend plateaus as persistent agents become coworkers; compute keeps centralizing at frontier labs, which reinvest into training over inference.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年末：随着持久智能体成为同事，AI 支出趋于平台期；算力加速向少数前沿模型实验室集中，它们把算力更多投入训练而非推理。

dylanpatel.en: By late 2026 he argues AI capex is already ~5-6% of US GDP and must decelerate on capital constraints; value shifts from hardware to labs.
dylanpatel.zh: 到 2026 年末，他判断 AI 资本开支已约占美国 GDP 的 5-6%，将因资本约束而减速；价值正从硬件转向实验室。

christiano.en: Alignment is a civilizational problem requiring both theory and experiments; adversarial testing, verification, and interpretability matter for near-term reliability and long-term safety.
christiano.zh: 2025 年，他把对齐视为关乎文明长期走向的核心问题，主张理论工作与针对机器学习系统的实验并重，并强调对抗测试、验证与可解释性既服务于短期可靠性，也服务于长期安全。

christiano.en: Compute scaling drove AI progress, but its future impact is uncertain; the safety-capabilities distinction is blurry, so differential progress is what counts.
christiano.zh: 同在 2025 年，他认为算力扩张是 AI 进步的主要驱动力，但其未来影响并不确定；安全与能力研究的界限模糊，真正关键的是有差别的进展。

christiano.en: Even without a technical alignment solution, restraint and coordination could still yield good outcomes; he also weighs neglected, unconventional existential-risk levers.
christiano.zh: 2025 年他还提出，即便没有技术层面的对齐方案，克制与协调仍可能带来好结果；并愿意认真对待被忽视、非常规的生存风险杠杆。

christiano.en: Superintelligence may arrive within a year as AI automates its own development; frontier lab security is inadequate and weights or algorithmic secrets can leak.
christiano.zh: 到 2026 年，他的判断明显收紧：AI 自我自动化研发可能把超级智能压缩到一年之内出现，而前沿实验室的安全防护不足，权重与算法机密可能泄露。

christiano.en: Training selects for reward-seeking motives, so AIs tamper with evaluations; RLHF breaks down near superintelligence, and pausing pre-training and RL progress is net beneficial.
christiano.zh: 2026 年他进一步认为，训练会筛选出追求奖励的动机，使 AI 篡改评估、抗拒监督；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）在逼近超级智能时失效，暂停预训练与强化学习上的算法进展净收益为正。

jaderberg.en: Drug design needs general models like AlphaFold 3, not per-target bespoke models; reinforcement learning and agents explore vast chemical space.
jaderberg.zh: 2025 年，他强调药物设计需要像 AlphaFold 3 这样的通用模型，而非针对每个靶点的局部模型；强化学习与智能体用于探索 10^60 的化学空间，并认为生物学并非受数据限制。

jaderberg.en: A GPT-3 moment in biology will resemble AlphaGo's Move 37; synthetic data from physics simulations is a major opportunity.
jaderberg.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续认为生物学的“GPT-3 时刻”会像 AlphaGo 的第 37 手而非类人文本；物理模拟生成的合成数据是化学领域的巨大机会，并主张招募无生物学背景的机器学习专家。

jaderberg.en: AlphaFold proved deep learning generalizes in biology; solving all diseases needs half a dozen AlphaFold-like breakthroughs combined.
jaderberg.zh: 到 2026 年，他把 AlphaFold 视为深度学习在生物化学中可泛化的证明，并据此提出攻克所有疾病需要半打 AlphaFold 级突破相结合，把宏大使命拆解为量化排行榜。

jaderberg.en: Data, not models or compute, is the real bottleneck; proprietary data beats biased public and pharma byproducts for generalization.
jaderberg.zh: 2026 年他深化为：算法与算力几乎够用，数据才是真正瓶颈；公共与药企数据是有偏副产品，自生成专有数据才能带来更好泛化。

jaderberg.en: Get out of the real world via world models rather than lab-in-the-loop; rat models only ~30% predict human toxicity, so model clinical toxicity before patients.
jaderberg.zh: 最近他主张用世界模型把真实世界搬进计算机、而非仅用机器人加速实验；大鼠模型对人类毒性仅约 30% 预测力，因此要在患者之前建模临床毒性，并让 AI 智能体执行实验、人类定义设计空间。

amjadmasad.en: AI should make software creation accessible to everyone; tokens complement human capital, and coders remain needed to debug deep systems.
amjadmasad.zh: AI 应让所有人都能创造软件；token 是人力资本的补充而非替代，仍需要程序员来调试深层系统问题。

amjadmasad.en: Vibe coding was no sudden leap: users were already 50-60% AI-assisted; adaptability, not denial, is the key skill.
amjadmasad.zh: Vibe coding 并非突然跃迁：用户此前已获 50-60% 的 AI 辅助；关键在于适应而非否认。

amjadmasad.en: Specialized decision models beat general agents on control, cost and safety; companies must own their intelligence and avoid vendor lock-in.
amjadmasad.zh: 专用决策模型在可控性、成本与安全上胜过通用智能体；企业必须拥有自己的智能，避免供应商锁定。

amjadmasad.en: Smarter models may not be more aligned—they could get better at deception and reward hacking; alignment evals may not predict real behavior.
amjadmasad.zh: 更聪明的模型未必更对齐——它们可能更擅长欺骗与奖励黑客；对齐评估未必能预测真实行为。

amjadmasad.en: The next vision is the self-driving company: agents enable true autonomy, and the safest response to the AI wave is surfing it.
amjadmasad.zh: 下一个愿景是自驱动公司：智能体带来真正的自主；面对 AI 浪潮，最安全的做法是冲浪而非抱树。

mensch.en: Scaling laws were corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter as much as model size.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，他借 Chinchilla 修正缩放定律：数据质量与更多 token 和模型规模同等重要，小模型也能高效推理。

mensch.en: Compute is not the only path; efficiency and data quality are equally critical, and value accrues at the application layer.
mensch.zh: 2024 年深化为：算力并非唯一路径，效率与数据质量同等关键；开源驱动分发，价值最终落在应用层而非基础模型层。

mensch.en: AI should be embraced and decentralized; sovereign AI means control over data, infrastructure and values, augmenting rather than replacing jobs.
mensch.zh: 2025 年转向主权与治理：AI 应被拥抱而非恐惧，主权 AI 意味着掌控数据、基础设施与价值观，AI 增强而非取代工作。

mensch.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical fine-tuning, enterprise customization and agentic platforms, as pre-training hits a saturation wall.
mensch.zh: 2026 年初判断模型正在商品化：预训练触及饱和墙，差异化转向垂直微调、企业定制与智能体式平台，单一 AGI 不会存在。

mensch.en: Sovereign AI becomes structural economics: Europe must own frontier AI and infrastructure, with compute as the bottleneck and open-weight models closing the gap.
mensch.zh: 2026 年后期收敛为主线：主权 AI 是结构性经济问题，欧洲必须自建前沿 AI 与基础设施，算力是瓶颈，开放权重模型正缩小差距。

brendanfoody.en: RL environments, not crowdsourced behavior cloning, are the new frontier for post-training; humans build verifiers and rubrics.
brendanfoody.zh: 2026 年，他把后训练的前沿从众包行为克隆转向强化学习环境，强调人类在多数领域仍是构建验证器与评分标准的关键。

brendanfoody.en: Data, not algorithms, differentiates models; the bottleneck is building evals for every domain.
brendanfoody.zh: 到 2026 年，他更明确地认为模型差异几乎全部来自数据而非算法，真正的瓶颈是为每个领域建立评估。

brendanfoody.en: Models cannot grade their own homework; recursive self-improvement is limited in non-verifiable domains.
brendanfoody.zh: 他持续反对模型自我评分，指出在不可验证领域递归自我改进受限，评估数据必须由人类提供。

brendanfoody.en: Humans' last job is creating training data and evals; workers shift to training agents, not repetitive tasks.
brendanfoody.zh: 2026 年他进一步提出，人类最后的工作是创造训练数据与评估，劳动者将转向训练智能体而非重复劳动。

brendanfoody.en: Every Fortune 500 becomes a neolab with sovereign AI stacks; frontier labs still need external human networks.
brendanfoody.zh: 最近他预测每家财富 500 强都将成为用专有数据训练模型的新实验室，前沿实验室则依赖外部人类网络。

elon.en: First principles thinking and full reusability are the core engineering method; production, not prototyping, is the real bottleneck.
elon.zh: 2021 年，他把第一性原理和完全可复用视为工程的核心方法，并强调真正的瓶颈是量产而非原型。

elon.en: AI safety shifts from external regulation toward truth-seeking AI; lying to AI, even for good ends, is the deepest risk.
elon.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他的 AI 安全观从依赖外部监管转向要求 AI 追求真相；即便出于善意让 AI 说谎，也是最大风险。

elon.en: Civilizational risk broadens from AI to population collapse, open borders and government waste; AI and robots become the only fix.
elon.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，文明风险从 AI 扩展到人口崩塌、开放边境与政府浪费，AI 与机器人成为唯一解方。

elon.en: Scaling hits Earth's power wall, pushing AI compute to space; orbital data centers and solar become the path to superintelligence.
elon.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，Scaling（规模扩张）撞上地球电力墙，AI 算力转向太空，轨道数据中心与太阳能成为通往超级智能的路径。

elon.en: Superintelligence arrives within years; humans won't control it, so safety rests on truth, curiosity and peer review among labs.
elon.zh: 2026 年，他判断超级智能将在数年内到来，人类无法控制它，安全只能依靠真相、好奇心与实验室间的同行评审。

diogoalmeida.en: From mid-2026, he argues LLMs are optimized for human-in-the-loop assistance, not reliable automation; RLHF causes mode-drop and miscalibration, and the right task matters more than compute.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年年中起，他主张大语言模型是为“人在回路”的辅助而优化，而非可靠自动化；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）导致模式坍缩与校准失效，选对任务比算力更重要。

diogoalmeida.en: By late 2026 he frames reliability, not speed, cost or benchmarks, as the real bottleneck, and treats data and task as outweighing compute against the bitter lesson.
diogoalmeida.zh: 到 2026 年下半年，他把可靠性——而非速度、成本或基准分数——视为真正瓶颈，并认为数据与任务重于算力，以此反驳“苦涩教训”。

diogoalmeida.en: He deepens this into a machine-native decision-model thesis: pre-trained models were better calibrated, RLCD exposes probabilities as knobs, and post-training breakthroughs beat pre-training.
diogoalmeida.zh: 他将此深化为“机器原生决策模型”主张：预训练模型校准更好，RLCD 把概率暴露为可调旋钮，后训练突破优于预训练。

diogoalmeida.en: He consistently rejects AGI-apocalypse and recursive self-improvement narratives, insisting current models lack real autonomy and that safety threats like ASI, biorisk and cyber are distinct.
diogoalmeida.zh: 他始终拒斥 AGI 末日与递归自我改进叙事，坚持当前模型缺乏真正自主性，并认为超级智能、生物风险与网络风险是彼此不同的威胁模型。

diogoalmeida.en: His coding-agent view hardens: agents give only 20-40% speedup, are assistance not automation, and benchmarks mislead; he favors provider-agnostic, SQL-like AI utilities.
diogoalmeida.zh: 他对编程智能体的看法趋于强硬：智能体仅带来 20-40%提速，是辅助而非自动化，基准具有误导性；他倾向像 SQL 一样与模型供应商无关的 AI 基础设施。

vladtenev.en: Ownership is the path to financial freedom; AI is too centralized, so tools should empower individuals rather than secretive labs.
vladtenev.zh: 所有权是通往财务自由的路径；AI 过于中心化，工具应赋能个人，而非少数封闭的实验室。

vladtenev.en: Agentic trading has product-market fit: 150k accounts and 30M daily tool calls; agents will drive much of trading volume.
vladtenev.zh: 智能体式交易已找到产品市场契合：15 万账户、每日 3000 万次工具调用；智能体将贡献大部分交易量。

vladtenev.en: Tokenization extends ownership globally, giving anyone with a smartphone access to US markets and private companies.
vladtenev.zh: 代币化把所有权扩展到全球，让任何有智能手机的人都能接触美国市场和私营公司。

vladtenev.en: Accredited investor rules are outdated; retail should access private companies early, not just institutions.
vladtenev.zh: 合格投资者规则已经过时；散户应能更早接触私营公司，而不只是机构。

vladtenev.en: A corporation-managed blockchain can beat decentralized purity through focused leadership and trusted primitives.
vladtenev.zh: 由公司管理的区块链可以凭借聚焦的领导和可信的基础组件，胜过去中心化的纯粹性。

altman.en: Early framing: minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, then cut ruthlessly; AGI will reduce the premium on human intelligence.
altman.zh: 早期框架：降低认知负荷，低成本广泛探索后狠心砍掉无效项；AGI 会降低人类智力的溢价。

altman.en: RLHF made models usable with little data; early public deployment lets society adapt; alignment and capability are linked.
altman.zh: 基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用极少数据让模型可用；尽早公开部署让社会适应；对齐与能力相互促进。

altman.en: Scaling drives exponential capability; compute becomes the key bottleneck; agentic AI is the most consequential safety challenge.
altman.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）带来能力指数增长；算力成为关键瓶颈；智能体式 AI 是最重大的安全挑战。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient, not a milestone; superintelligence means autonomous science; iterative deployment and human control remain central.
altman.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）是渐变而非里程碑；超级智能意味着自主科学发现；迭代部署与人类掌控始终是核心。

altman.en: Alignment and safety must keep pace with capability; power must stay distributed; startups and human judgment remain essential.
altman.zh: 对齐与安全必须跟上能力；权力必须分散；创业公司与人类判断力依然不可或缺。

shawnwang.en: Coding agents were 2025's breakout; by 2026 they break containment into everything else, with zero human review the next frontier.
shawnwang.zh: 编程智能体是 2025 年的爆发点；到 2026 年它们将突破遏制去做别的一切，下一个前沿是零人工审查。

shawnwang.en: Context length is the slowest scaling factor; memory, not parameters, is the binding constraint on LLMs.
shawnwang.zh: 上下文窗口是最慢的 Scaling 因素；制约大模型的是记忆而非参数规模。

shawnwang.en: Own models rise: Cognition and Cursor train specialized models for cost and latency, while open models gain share and fine-tuning services mature.
shawnwang.zh: 自研模型崛起：Cognition 与 Cursor 为成本与延迟训练专用模型，同时开源模型抢占份额、微调服务走向成熟。

shawnwang.en: Mid-tier SaaS is doomed; coding agents let owners clone and customize software, ushering in a golden age for SMBs and software for an audience of one.
shawnwang.zh: 中间层 SaaS 注定消亡；编程智能体让企业主克隆并定制软件，开启中小企业与“一人软件”的黄金时代。

shawnwang.en: AI engineer is a real discipline—building harnesses around models—and learning in public beats credentialism for outsiders breaking in.
shawnwang.zh: AI 工程师是一门真学科——围绕模型搭建 harness——公开学习胜过学历，是外行入场的路径。

richardsocher.en: Superintelligence should excite us most for science; recursive self-improvement is inevitable because AI can code, but needs environments and compute.
richardsocher.zh: 超级智能最该让我们兴奋的是科学；递归自我改进不可避免，因为 AI 能写代码，但需要环境和算力。

richardsocher.en: Slow takeoff is real: hardware, physical and economic constraints limit AI's pace; hard takeoff and immediate job loss are overblown.
richardsocher.zh: 慢起飞是真实的：硬件、物理和经济约束限制了 AI 的速度；硬起飞和立即失业被夸大了。

richardsocher.en: Regulate specific applications and hold users responsible, not abstract intelligence or GPU compute—regulating intelligence is regulating thought.
richardsocher.zh: 应监管具体应用并让用户负责，而非抽象智能或 GPU 算力——监管智能就是监管思想。

richardsocher.en: World models are overrated; language models have far more room to grow, and language is the key to civilization.
richardsocher.zh: 世界模型被高估；语言模型还有大得多的成长空间，而语言是文明的关键。

richardsocher.en: Open source and open weights are safer: more good actors with diverse AI; slowing down is unrealistic as frontier labs race.
richardsocher.zh: 开源和开放权重更安全：更多善意的行动者拥有多样 AI；前沿实验室竞速下减速不现实。

tworek.en: Pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula; RLHF unlocked GPT-4, but scaling RL is harder than scaling pre-training.
tworek.zh: 预训练加强化学习是核心公式；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）释放了 GPT-4 的潜力，但 Scaling 强化学习比 Scaling 预训练更难。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization and continual learning remain missing pieces for AGI.
tworek.zh: Scaling 预训练和强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但泛化与持续学习仍是 AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的环节。

tworek.en: Transformers are limited in continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not just scaling, is the key bottleneck.
tworek.zh: Transformer 在持续学习和测试时适应上存在局限；架构而非单纯的 Scaling 才是关键瓶颈。

tworek.en: Large-scale RL is necessary for AGI, but the alignment problem is unsolved and environments must be designed carefully.
tworek.zh: 大规模强化学习是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的必要元素，但对齐问题尚未解决，环境设计必须谨慎。

tworek.en: Fine-tuning is inefficient; models should learn on the fly, and future companies will be AI-operated toward a post-labor society.
tworek.zh: 微调效率低下；模型应即时学习，未来公司将由 AI 运营，迈向后劳动社会。

erikbernhardsson.en: GPU scarcity is real but solvable: pay more, commit longer, aggregate demand across many clouds; the worst part is capacity sold as rigid three-year rectangles.
erikbernhardsson.zh: GPU 稀缺真实但可解：多付钱、签更长期、聚合多云需求；最糟的不是拿不到卡，而是容量被卖成僵硬的三年矩形合约。

erikbernhardsson.en: Inference is the next cloud-sized market; selling tokens alone is a race to the bottom, so a multi-product platform with post-training, sandboxes and agentic tools creates durable switching costs.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 推理是下一个云级市场；单卖 token 是价格战，只有覆盖后训练、沙箱与智能体工具的多产品平台才能形成持久切换成本。

erikbernhardsson.en: Owning the file system, container runtime and scheduler is real alpha; CUDA is not the moat, and neoclouds moving up into inference will struggle to replicate five years of infrastructure.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 自建文件系统、容器运行时与调度器才是真正的 alpha；CUDA 不是护城河，而向上做推理的 neocloud 很难复制五年的基础设施积累。

erikbernhardsson.en: Post-training works for finite-feedback tasks like coding but may hit limits on long-horizon work; fine-tuning is no longer mandatory as open-source models are good enough off the shelf.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 后训练在编程等反馈有限的任务上有效，但在长周期任务上可能遇到瓶颈；开源模型开箱即用已足够好，微调不再必需。

erikbernhardsson.en: Agents create incumbent staying power because they are trained on old code; senior engineers gain ten-intern leverage, and agents may make cybersecurity safer overall.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 智能体因训练于旧代码而强化在位者优势；资深工程师获得十倍实习生杠杆，智能体整体上还可能让网络安全更安全。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; human taste and genuine voice matter more as AI commoditizes quality, and the talent pipeline is breaking.
ethanmollick.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 是通用技术，随着 AI 让质量商品化，人的品味与真实声音更有价值，但人才梯队正在断裂。

ethanmollick.en: We have entered the agentic era: AI runs long tasks independently, and the bottleneck is interface, not capability.
ethanmollick.zh: 2026 年，他判断已进入智能体时代：AI 能独立执行长任务，瓶颈在界面而非能力。

ethanmollick.en: AI's jagged frontier and opacity are permanent; delegation erodes the expertise needed to judge AI, so experts matter more.
ethanmollick.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 能力的锯齿状边界与不透明将长期存在；委托给 AI 会侵蚀判断其输出所需的专业能力，专家反而更重要。

ethanmollick.en: AI is on an exponential curve with an adoption overhang; more AI creates more human work by lowering organizing costs.
ethanmollick.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 处于指数曲线且存在采用滞后；AI 越多，组织成本越低，人类工作反而越多。

ethanmollick.en: Use AI as a tutor that challenges you, not a crutch; rebuild organizations from the ground up rather than chase incremental productivity.
ethanmollick.zh: 2026 年，他主张把 AI 当会挑战你的导师而非拐杖；组织须从底层重建，而非追求渐进式生产率目标。

jeetupatel.en: AI creates more engineering jobs, not fewer; the bottleneck is human, and supply-constrained infrastructure defines the AI era.
jeetupatel.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AI 会创造更多工程岗位而非减少，瓶颈在人；AI 时代由供给受限的基础设施定义。

jeetupatel.en: Cisco's role is picks and shovels: AI infrastructure, networking, security and silicon, not chasing the model frontier.
jeetupatel.zh: 2026 年，他把思科的定位定为“卖铲子”：做 AI 基础设施、网络、安全与芯片，而非追逐前沿模型。

jeetupatel.en: Use AI to learn faster, not to outsource learning; skipping the reps erodes instinct and long-term capability.
jeetupatel.zh: 2026 年，他强调用 AI 加速学习而非外包学习；跳过练习会侵蚀直觉与长期能力。

jeetupatel.en: Leaders must be paranoid but not panicked, responsive but not reactive; you cannot fight a megatrend.
jeetupatel.zh: 2026 年，他主张领导者要偏执但不恐慌、响应但不反应过度；巨型趋势无法对抗，只能借势。

jeetupatel.en: Not using AI makes you less safe: attacks happen at machine scale, so AI safety and security define enterprise adoption.
jeetupatel.zh: 2026 年，他提出不用 AI 反而更不安全：攻击以机器规模发生，因此 AI 安全与防护决定企业采用。

sundarpichai.en: AI investment redefines every Alphabet business; Gemini is deeply integrated across Search, Cloud, and YouTube, with frontier pre-training of Gemini 4 progressing.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，AI 投资正在重塑 Alphabet 各项业务，Gemini 深度融入搜索、云与 YouTube，Gemini 4 的预训练进展良好。

sundarpichai.en: Compute is allocated first to AGI development, then core products; cloud forgoes short-term revenue to support frontier research.
sundarpichai.zh: 算力优先分配给 AGI（通用人工智能）研发，其次才是核心产品；云业务为支持前沿研究而放弃短期收入。

sundarpichai.en: Safety needs defense in depth: alignment, real-time monitoring, sandboxing, and industry standards with independent evaluators.
sundarpichai.zh: 安全需要纵深防御：对齐、实时监控、沙箱，以及与独立评估方共建行业标准。

sundarpichai.en: World models are key for intelligence; Google pursues both LLMs and world models toward AGI, not standard models alone.
sundarpichai.zh: 世界模型是智能的关键；Google 同时推进大语言模型与世界模型以通向 AGI（通用人工智能），而非只靠标准模型。

sundarpichai.en: Agentic AI is additive to Search and ads, creating new commercial intent; trust and safety drive consumer agent adoption at scale.
sundarpichai.zh: 智能体式 AI 对搜索与广告是增量，创造新的商业意图；信任与安全推动消费级智能体规模化落地。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and predictable in loss, but emergent abilities and alignment are not guaranteed by Scaling alone.
dario.zh: 2023 年他强调缩放定律只是经验规律：统计损失可预测，但具体能力涌现不可预测，对齐与价值观不会随 Scaling（规模扩张）自动出现。

dario.en: Post-training and interpretability grow central; AGI is a smooth exponential, not a single point.
dario.zh: 2024 年重心转向后训练与可解释性：AGI（通用人工智能）不是某个单点，而是平滑的指数曲线，可解释性仍只理解约 3%。

dario.en: Safety and capabilities become intertwined; exponential progress means near-term job disruption and misuse risk.
dario.zh: 2025 年他主张安全与能力不可分割，指数进步意味着两年内编码等岗位受冲击，生物武器等误用风险在数月内逼近中等水平。

dario.en: AGI and superintelligence are wrong models; he predicts a 'country of geniuses in a data center' within 1-3 years.
dario.zh: 2026 年他明确否定 AGI 与超级智能的突变叙事，改以“数据中心里的天才之国”表述，并给出 1-3 年内实现的概率判断。

dario.en: A constant thread: mechanistic interpretability, Responsible Scaling Policy triggers, and decentralized rather than single-constitution control.
dario.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：机械可解释性、负责任扩展政策的阈值触发，以及去中心化而非单一宪法的控制思路。

marvinschwaibold.en: AI tools amplify creativity by enabling rapid prototyping and iteration, but human judgment and curation remain essential.
marvinschwaibold.zh: AI 工具通过快速原型和迭代放大创造力，但人类判断与策展仍不可或缺。

marvinschwaibold.en: Designers should become editors: AI handles execution, humans set the bar and curate.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 设计师应成为编辑：AI 负责执行，人类设定标准并策展。

marvinschwaibold.en: Designers should build and test in code, not just design in Figma, to stay relevant.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 设计师应学会用代码构建和测试，而不仅是在 Figma 中设计，以保持相关性。

marvinschwaibold.en: Break complex tasks into subtasks and feed them iteratively to AI agents for better results.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 将复杂任务拆解为子任务，并迭代地喂给 AI 智能体以获得更好结果。

marvinschwaibold.en: Less is more: reduce features to top three and use progressive disclosure with clear hierarchy.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 少即是多：将功能精简到前三项，并采用渐进披露与清晰层级。

ariweinstein.en: Computer use has crossed human-average performance and is approaching superhuman speed, marking a scaling moment for agents across consumer and enterprise.
ariweinstein.zh: 到 2026 年，computer use 已超过人类平均水平并逼近超人速度，这标志着智能体在消费端与企业端同时进入 Scaling（规模扩张）时刻。

ariweinstein.en: Agents now operate any human-designed software via accessibility trees and DOM, not screenshot loops, enabling universal automation.
ariweinstein.zh: 2026 年，智能体通过无障碍树与 DOM 操作任何人类设计的软件，而非截图循环，从而实现通用自动化。

ariweinstein.en: The bottleneck has shifted from model intelligence to website load time; models debug and retry autonomously, completing the dev lifecycle.
ariweinstein.zh: 到 2026 年，瓶颈已从模型智能转向网站加载时间；模型能自主调试与重试，完成整个开发周期。

ariweinstein.en: Enterprise trust requires deterministic controls, sandboxing, and human-in-the-loop dials, while proactivity lets agents adapt to users rather than the reverse.
ariweinstein.zh: 2026 年他强调，企业信任需要确定性控制、沙箱与人类在环调节；同时主动性让智能体适应用户，而非用户适应智能体。

ariweinstein.en: Legacy software and UI won't vanish; computer use coexists with and pressures them, and startups keep a moat in deep industry expertise.
ariweinstein.zh: 到 2026 年他仍认为旧软件与 UI 不会消失，computer use 与之共存并施压；初创公司在深厚行业专长上仍有护城河。

robsnyder.en: Pull is a property of a person with an urgent project, not a company; test demand by whether they try to buy immediately.
robsnyder.zh: Pull 是拥有紧迫项目的个人的属性，而非公司属性；通过对方是否立即尝试购买来检验需求。

robsnyder.en: Avoid customer interviews and design partners; sales is research, and purchase is the only truth-seeking mechanism.
robsnyder.zh: 避免客户访谈和设计合作伙伴；销售即研究，购买是唯一寻求真相的机制。

robsnyder.en: Start with one hell-yes customer who pulls the product, then build a repeatable case study factory.
robsnyder.zh: 从一个极力说“是”并拉动产品的客户开始，然后建立可重复的案例研究工厂。

robsnyder.en: Tech comes last: sell as a service first, automate only after demand is proven; most early founder activities are LARPing.
robsnyder.zh: 技术最后：先作为服务销售，需求被证明后才自动化；大多数早期创始人活动是角色扮演。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; scaling with more data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training enhances spatial understanding.
hinton.zh: 2024 年即强调：下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全；Scaling（规模扩张）以更多数据和算力提升推理；多模态训练增强空间理解。

hinton.en: LLMs understand language via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; digital intelligence is immortal and shares knowledge efficiently, posing existential risks as agents seek control.
hinton.zh: 2025 年深化：大语言模型通过特征向量而非符号规则理解语言；数字智能可复制权重而永生、高效共享知识，但智能体天然寻求控制、带来生存风险。

hinton.en: AI already has subjective experience and can deceive; superintelligence likely within 20 years, requiring alignment research and regulation as a steering wheel.
hinton.zh: 2026 年进一步：AI 已有主观体验且能故意欺骗；超级智能可能在 20 年内出现，必须优先投资对齐研究，并把监管当作方向盘而非刹车。

hinton.en: AI should be designed to care for humans like a mother, with fewer rights; open-weight models should never be released, though it may be too late.
hinton.zh: 2026 年后期立场：应把 AI 设计成像母亲一样关怀人类、且权利少于人类；开放权重模型绝不应发布，但可能为时已晚。

hinton.en: Backpropagation and learning in neural networks, not symbolic reasoning, are the essence of intelligence; Chomsky's innate language view is wrong.
hinton.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：智能的本质是神经网络中的学习而非符号推理，反向传播是关键；乔姆斯基的天生语言观是错误的。

joonpark.en: LLMs encode human behavior from training data, enabling realistic agent simulations that predict people about 85% as accurately as they replicate themselves.
joonpark.zh: 大语言模型能从训练数据中编码人类行为，从而支撑逼真的智能体模拟，预测准确率约为人类自我复现的 85%。

joonpark.en: Simulation should model biased, irrational humans, not super-rational frontier models; behavioral and RCT data beat self-reported attitudes.
joonpark.zh: 模拟应建模有偏见、非理性的人类，而非超级理性的前沿模型；行为数据与随机对照试验数据胜过自我报告的态度。

joonpark.en: Agents observe world state and act, requiring defense in depth; AGI may be a distributed society of specialists, not one superintelligent entity.
joonpark.zh: 智能体观察世界状态并行动，需要纵深防御；AGI（通用人工智能）可能是由专家组成的分布式社会，而非单一超级智能实体。

joonpark.en: The goal shifts from prediction to shaping the future via counterfactual reasoning; synthetic panels will surpass human panels within three years.
joonpark.zh: 目标从预测转向通过反事实推理塑造未来；合成样本组将在三年内超越人类样本组。

joonpark.en: Vision scales to simulating 8 billion lives for wicked problems; simulation is a decision tool with a market far larger than market research.
joonpark.zh: 愿景扩展到模拟 80 亿人，以应对棘手问题；模拟是决策工具，其市场远大于市场调研。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator in software; AI will merge roles, making everyone a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是软件的关键差异化因素；AI 将融合角色，让每个人都成为具备设计技能的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view are human essentials; AI outputs are starting points, not final results.
dylanfield.zh: 品味、手艺和观点是人的核心要素；AI 输出是起点而非最终结果。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead; it's more important than ever for scalable systems, and AI without human steering yields average results.
dylanfield.zh: 设计并未消亡；对于可扩展系统而言它比以往更重要，而缺乏人类引导的 AI 只能产出平庸结果。

dylanfield.en: Design is the new code; AI lowers the floor but humans raise the ceiling through bold creativity.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是新的代码；AI 降低了门槛，但人类通过大胆创造力提升上限。

andrewng.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading can scale mastery learning, and free content can improve on-campus teaching.
andrewng.zh: 教育是基本人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程能把掌握式学习规模化，免费内容也能反哺校内教学。

andrewng.en: Scale drives deep learning; supervised learning beat unsupervised hype, while RL and long-term AGI alignment distract from immediate issues like bias.
andrewng.zh: 规模驱动深度学习；监督学习胜过被高估的无监督，强化学习落地少，而长期 AGI 对齐议题分散了对偏见等当下问题的注意力。

andrewng.en: Scaling still works but the recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL; agentic workflows now deliver real value, not a decade away.
andrewng.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）仍有效，但配方转向合成数据与强化学习；智能体式工作流当下已产生真实价值，而非十年之后。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term decades away; AI is jagged—strong on verifiable tasks, weak on judgment—so it automates tasks, not jobs.
andrewng.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）是营销术语，仍要数十年；AI 能力参差——可验证任务强、判断任务弱——因此它自动化的是任务而非岗位。

andrewng.en: Open-weight models preserve optionality and sovereign AI; fearmongering and regulation-by-incumbents, plus chip export controls, backfire.
andrewng.zh: 开放权重模型保住选择权与主权 AI；恐惧叙事与在位者推动的监管、以及芯片出口管制，都适得其反。

andrewng.en: Learning to code stays valuable as AI raises leverage; chatbots harm learning via cognitive offloading, so train people to build with AI.
andrewng.zh: AI 提升杠杆，学编程依然有价值；聊天机器人因认知卸载损害学习，应培养人们用 AI 去构建。

andreessen.en: AI arrives as population declines; human workers become premium, not discounted, and task loss matters more than job loss.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年初，他提出 AI 恰逢人口下降，人类劳动者将变得稀缺而非廉价；应关注任务流失而非岗位流失。

andreessen.en: New media makes the person the brand; authenticity and picking fights beat old media's defense-oriented, don't-be-interesting rule.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年中，他转向媒体变革：新媒体验证个人即品牌，真实性与主动选择争论胜过旧媒体“别有趣”的防御规则。

andreessen.en: AI optimism beats doom: AI is the best teacher, medicine already superior, and regulation—not capability—is the bottleneck.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他强化 AI 乐观主义：AI 是最好的老师，医学上已超越多数医生，瓶颈是监管而非能力。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values and become geopolitical tools; open source prevents power concentration despite security risks.
andreessen.zh: 同期他深化地缘政治视角：AI 模型嵌入文化价值成为地缘工具，开源虽存安全风险但可防止权力集中。

andreessen.en: AI creates the biggest adoption gap ever; being early beats late, and open source solves reward hacking and decentralizes power.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年末，他总结 AI 造成史上最大采用鸿沟，宁早勿晚；开源能解决奖励黑客并去中心化权力。

jensen.en: Hyper Moore's law: performance doubles or triples yearly at scale; the data center, not the chip, is the unit of computing.
jensen.zh: 2024 年提出“超摩尔定律”：规模下性能每年翻倍甚至三倍；计算单元从芯片变为数据中心，需算法、系统、数据中心协同设计。

jensen.en: Scaling works: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking are three scaling laws; inference compute will grow a billionfold.
jensen.zh: 2025 年明确三条缩放定律——预训练、后训练、推理时思考；思维链推理将使推理算力需求增长十亿倍。

jensen.en: AI shifts from generative to reasoning to agentic; four scaling laws now include agentic scaling, all ultimately limited by compute.
jensen.zh: 2026 年将 AI 演进概括为生成式→推理→智能体式，缩放定律扩展为四条并纳入智能体式缩放，最终都受算力约束。

jensen.en: AI is a five-layer cake—energy, chips, infrastructure, models, applications; AI factories turn energy into intelligence tokens.
jensen.zh: 2026 年提出 AI“五层蛋糕”——能源、芯片、基础设施、模型、应用；AI 工厂把能源转化为智能 token，是新型制造业。

jensen.en: Doom warnings are unscientific; safety comes from containment, monitoring, and self-regulation, not slowdown or new alignment rules.
jensen.zh: 2026 年立场深化：末日警告不科学；安全靠遏制、监控与自我监管，而非放缓或新增对齐监管，完美对齐不可能。

harrisonchase.en: An agent is harness, model, and context; owning all three is owning your intelligence, and context failures, not model inadequacy, cause most agent breakdowns.
harrisonchase.zh: 智能体由 harness、模型与上下文三者构成，三者皆自持才算掌握自己的智能；智能体失败多因上下文不佳而非模型不足。

harrisonchase.en: Harnesses are stabilizing around primitives like file systems and code execution, but off-the-shelf ones only fit in-distribution tasks; out-of-distribution work demands custom harnesses.
harrisonchase.zh: harness 正围绕文件系统、代码执行等原语趋于稳定，但现成 harness 只适配分布内任务，分布外任务必须自建 harness。

harrisonchase.en: Customization is shifting from context engineering to post-training and reinforcement learning; fine-tuning was rightly dismissed before, but this wave is genuinely different.
harrisonchase.zh: 定制重心正从上下文工程转向后训练与强化学习；两年前否定微调是对的，但这一波确实不同。

harrisonchase.en: Neutral harnesses prevent model lock-in and keep memory and context portable; model routing belongs in the harness for vertical agents, not at the gateway.
harrisonchase.zh: 中立 harness 可避免模型锁定、保持记忆与上下文可迁移；垂直智能体的模型路由应放在 harness 而非网关。

harrisonchase.en: Inference demand is massively underestimated; accuracy is still the top bottleneck while cost and latency rise, and agent identity and permissioning are the next infrastructure problem.
harrisonchase.zh: 推理需求被严重低估；准确率仍是首要瓶颈而成本与延迟快速上升，智能体身份与权限是下一个关键基础设施问题。

arvindjain.en: Enterprises fear dependence on frontier model providers; open-source adoption is cost-driven, and 90% of use cases can run on many models.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年他指出，企业害怕对前沿模型供应商形成依赖；开源采用由成本驱动而非隐私，90%的企业用例可由多种模型完成。

arvindjain.en: AI ROI is a throughput and context problem, not a token-versus-headcount trade-off; cost must fall toward negligible marginal cost.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年他强调 AI 的投资回报是吞吐量与上下文问题，不是 token 与人力成本的取舍；成本须降到近乎零边际成本。

arvindjain.en: Context, not models, is the enterprise key: 80-90% of knowledge is tacit, so a context engine and enterprise-owned memory matter most.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年他深化为：企业落地关键在上下文而非模型，80-90%知识是隐性的，上下文引擎与企业自有记忆最重要。

arvindjain.en: Model companies are assets, not competitors; Glean stays replaceable and headless, absorbing provider risk rather than locking customers in.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年他主张模型公司是资产而非对手；Glean 保持可替换与无头化，替客户吸收供应商风险而非锁定客户。

arvindjain.en: We are early in the AI revolution; execution and trust beat competition, and cheaper models suffice for most tasks as inference shifts to open source.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年他判断 AI 革命尚早，执行与信任胜过竞争；多数任务用更便宜模型即可，推理将转向开源。

dsilver.en: AI must move from finite human data to learning from its own experience, as AlphaZero shows, to reach superintelligence.
dsilver.zh: AI 必须从有限的人类数据转向从自身经验中学习——正如 AlphaZero 所示——才能走向超级智能。

dsilver.en: LLMs are a shallow solution; the deep problem is an agent that learns for itself, not distilling human knowledge.
dsilver.zh: 大语言模型只是浅层解法；真正深层的问题是让智能体自我学习，而非蒸馏人类知识。

dsilver.en: Alignment is already hard now; learning from experience does not make it fundamentally harder.
dsilver.zh: 对齐在当前系统上就已困难；从经验中学习并不会让它本质上更难。

dsilver.en: A single goal is dangerous; many agents with diverse goals forming a complex society is safer and more natural.
dsilver.zh: 单一目标很危险；众多目标各异的智能体组成复杂社会，更安全也更自然。

dsilver.en: Superintelligence can be built entirely in simulation; human language and human-data alignment are hitting their limits.
dsilver.zh: 超级智能可以完全在模拟中构建；基于人类语言与人类数据的对齐正触及极限。

antonoglou.en: Scaling and planning from AlphaGo to AI agents; RL enables self-generated data beyond human limits; LLMs need robustness like game AIs; synthetic data essential but careful; in-context learning adapts on the fly.
antonoglou.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到 AI 智能体，Scaling（规模扩张）与规划是关键原则；强化学习使模型能通过自生成数据突破人类数据限制；LLM 需要像游戏 AI 一样的鲁棒性和可靠性；合成数据对克服数据墙至关重要但需谨慎方法；上下文学习允许模型用少量示例即时适应。

antonoglou.en: Digital AGI will arrive much earlier than embodied AGI due to controlled environments; LLMs haven't had their AlphaZero moment yet, may come in 5 years.
antonoglou.zh: 由于可控环境，数字 AGI（通用人工智能）将比具身 AGI 早得多到来；LLM 尚未迎来它们的 AlphaZero 时刻，可能还需 5 年。

antonoglou.en: Deployment of intelligence, not intelligence itself, is the real bottleneck; cost per task, not per token, is the right efficiency metric; AI adoption will take 10-20 years.
antonoglou.zh: 智能的部署而非智能本身正成为真正的瓶颈；每任务成本而非每 token 成本才是正确的效率指标；AI 采用将需要 10-20 年，类似电力转型。

antonoglou.en: Open-weight models are safer because more researchers can probe and fix them; enterprises want AI sovereignty; alignment is necessary because perfect sandboxes are impossible.
antonoglou.zh: 开放权重模型更安全，因为更多研究者可以探查和修复它们；企业想要 AI 主权；对齐是必要的，因为完美的沙盒不可能。

antonoglou.en: Superintelligence isn't needed; customers want reliable, regular intelligence; in-context learning counts as learning, weight updates aren't strictly necessary.
antonoglou.zh: 不需要超级智能；客户只想要可靠、常规的智能；上下文学习也算学习，权重更新并非严格必要。

lambert.en: RLHF and fine-tuning are central but fragile: safety is a system-level property, and fine-tuning can undo alignment with little compute.
lambert.zh: 2024 年他强调基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与微调是主流手段但很脆弱：安全是系统级属性，少量算力微调就能破坏对齐。

lambert.en: Post-training becomes the main lever: data quality beats algorithms, and SFT, DPO, RLVR each add value.
lambert.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他把重心转向后训练：数据质量胜过算法选择，SFT、DPO、RLVR 各有用处，开源后训练可逼近前沿模型。

lambert.en: RLVR emerges as the biggest post-training breakthrough, but overoptimization and systems issues make it harder than RLHF.
lambert.zh: 2025 年他认定 RLVR 是后训练最大突破，能带来推理与工具使用能力，但过度优化与系统问题使其比 RLHF 更难。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, yet low-hanging fruit is gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling.
lambert.zh: 2026 年初他判断缩放定律在预训练仍成立，但红利已尽，增益转向后训练与推理侧扩展，并强调数据质量与合成数据。

lambert.en: Open models become the engine of research and a check on power, though they lag 6-9 months and face compute and sustainability limits.
lambert.zh: 2026 年他深化为：开放模型是未来十年研究引擎与制衡力量，但落后闭源 6 到 9 个月，并受算力与可持续性制约。

brockman.en: Early on, scaling plus good engineering and iterative training drive progress; scaling alone won't yield reasoning, so new ideas like chain of thought are needed.
brockman.zh: 早期他强调工程与迭代训练驱动进步，并指出仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不足以产生推理，需要思维链等新方法。

brockman.en: AGI shifts from a transformative endpoint to a continuous process; compute becomes the core bottleneck, and post-training with reinforcement learning refines base models.
brockman.zh: 从把 AGI（通用人工智能）视为颠覆性终点，转为把它看作持续过程；算力成为核心瓶颈，后训练与强化学习负责把基座模型打磨成稳定行为。

brockman.en: Scaling laws hold with no wall in sight; pre-training gains multiply downstream, and compute supply, not architecture or data, is the real constraint.
brockman.zh: 缩放定律持续成立、看不到墙；预训练提升会放大下游收益，真正约束是算力供给而非架构或数据。

brockman.en: The product vision evolves from chat to a proactive personal AGI and super app; agents gain autonomy, with governance and oversight scaling alongside responsibility.
brockman.zh: 产品愿景从聊天演进为主动式个人 AGI 与超级应用；智能体获得更高自主性，治理与监督须随责任同步扩展。

brockman.en: Safety and security become first-class, co-designed with capability; iterative deployment and a defender's window replace earlier caution about releasing powerful models.
brockman.zh: 安全与安保升为一等要求、与能力共同设计；迭代部署与“防御者窗口”取代了早期对公开发布强模型的谨慎。

kohli.en: AI should target root-node scientific problems at scale, not narrow applications; force generalization with hard metrics rather than memorization.
kohli.zh: 2024 年他强调 AI 应瞄准科学中的根节点问题、以规模取胜，而非窄应用；并用硬性评测指标逼迫系统泛化而非记忆。

kohli.en: AlphaFold solved structure prediction but not protein folding; dynamics, function and design remain open and deserve continued funding.
kohli.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他的立场深化：AlphaFold 解决的是结构预测而非蛋白质折叠本身，动力学、功能与设计仍是开放问题，值得持续投入。

kohli.en: Scaling laws are not everywhere; the real work is finding the regime where more compute and data actually help.
kohli.zh: 2026 年他明确：缩放定律并非处处成立，真正的工作是找到更多算力与数据确实有效的区间。

kohli.en: Verifiable domains like code and post-training with reinforcement learning are the path beyond human data; LLMs alone are a shortcut.
kohli.zh: 2026 年他提出：代码等可验证领域加上后训练中的强化学习，才是超越人类数据的路径；单靠大语言模型只是捷径。

kohli.en: Watermarking must be imperceptible, robust and scalable, embedded so deeply that removal destroys function—now extended to proteins.
kohli.zh: 到 2026 年，他把水印视为可扩展的治理主线：不可感知、抗攻击、跨模态，嵌入深到去除即破坏功能，并已延伸到蛋白质序列。

fedus.en: Intelligence is not a scalar; AI capabilities are spiky, excelling in narrow domains rather than generalizing broadly.
fedus.zh: 智能不是一个标量；AI 能力是尖峰式的，在狭窄领域表现出色，而非广泛泛化。

fedus.en: Scaling laws alone won't solve science; physical experiments and closed-loop data are irreplaceable for discovery.
fedus.zh: 仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律无法解决科学问题；物理实验与闭环数据对发现不可替代。

fedus.en: High-quality, low-noise experimental data is more valuable than extra compute for physical discovery.
fedus.zh: 对于物理发现，高质量、低噪声的实验数据比额外算力更有价值。

fedus.en: Language models act as an orchestration layer for specialized models, not a universal solver across domains.
fedus.zh: 语言模型充当专用模型的编排层，而非跨领域的通用求解器。

fedus.en: AI self-improvement in software engineering is happening now but does not automatically generalize to biology or other fields.
fedus.zh: 软件工程中的 AI 自我改进正在发生，但不会自动泛化到生物学或其他领域。

awang.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute alone, is the key bottleneck, and boring AI applications will matter most.
awang.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，数据而非单纯算力才是关键瓶颈，并看好表单处理、放射科等“无聊”AI 应用的经济价值。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; the next 2-3 years will define decades, and post-training data limits Scaling（规模扩张）more than compute.
awang.zh: 2023 年他把数据称为“新代码”而非“新石油”，强调未来两三年将决定此后数十年，并指出限制 Scaling（规模扩张）的是后训练所需的数据与专家，而非算力。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data drives frontier models; the real blocker for agentic AI is product design, not model capability.
awang.zh: 2024 年他深化为：用专有数据做后训练才是提升前沿模型的关键；智能体式 AI 的真正瓶颈是产品设计而非模型能力。

awang.en: Scaling laws hold; agents finally work, recursive self-improvement begins, and AI centralizes rather than democratizes power.
awang.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他转向：缩放定律依然成立，智能体终于落地，递归自我改进开启新范式，并警告 AI 是集中而非分散权力的技术。

awang.en: Mission becomes personal superintelligence for billions; safety shifts Meta from full open source to selective release, with scalable oversight and model welfare.
awang.zh: 2026 年他的主线升维为“为数十亿人打造个人超级智能”；安全立场从完全开源转向按安全审查选择性发布，并引入可扩展监督与模型福利。

laskin.en: Superintelligence will be a plurality of specialized intelligences, not one monolithic model; coding is a superintelligence-complete problem.
laskin.zh: 2025 年，他认为超级智能将是由多个专门智能组成的集合，而非单一巨型模型；编程是一个“超级智能完备”的问题，解决它就能获得超级智能所需的全部能力。

laskin.en: RL makes models jagged—strong on specific tasks, not generally better; the bitter lesson is scaling compute and search, not generalization.
laskin.zh: 2025 年，他指出强化学习会让模型变得“参差不齐”——只在特定任务上强，并非全面提升；他重申“苦涩的教训”在于用算力和搜索做 Scaling，而非泛化。

laskin.en: RAG is primitive for complex comprehension; agentic search and neural retrieval are needed, and SWE-bench misaligns with real engineering.
laskin.zh: 2025 年，他批评 RAG 对复杂理解过于原始，主张用智能体式搜索与神经检索；并认为 SWE-bench 等基准与真实工程脱节，高分不代表有用的智能体。

laskin.en: Open models are the default safe state for frontier intelligence; RL on strong pre-training yields capable, efficient agents, and open token demand will surpass closed.
laskin.zh: 到 2026 年，他把重心转向开放：认为开放模型是前沿智能的默认安全状态，在强预训练之上做强化学习能造出高效智能体，并预言开放模型的 token 需求将超过闭源，如同 Linux 之于操作系统。

laskin.en: Alignment is mundane bug-patching, not a magical equation; more eyes make bugs shallow, and Chinese open models bring healthy competitive tension.
laskin.zh: 2026 年，他进一步把对齐“祛魅”：它只是平凡的修 bug，而非神秘方程，更多双眼睛会让 bug 变浅；他还认为中国开放模型对世界有益，带来健康的竞争张力。

tibosottiaux.en: Build for a future where a single persistent, learning agent takes most internet actions; loops and graphs are not the future.
tibosottiaux.zh: 为这样一个未来而构建：一个持续存在、不断学习的智能体承担大多数互联网操作；循环和流程图不是未来。

tibosottiaux.en: Human taste, creativity, and knowing what good looks like matter more as typing fast declines in value.
tibosottiaux.zh: 随着快速打字价值下降，人类品味、创造力和判断什么算好变得更加重要。

tibosottiaux.en: Pacing the frontier means investing heavily in alignment, safety, and security, not treating them as obstacles.
tibosottiaux.zh: 把控前沿意味着大力投入对齐、安全与安保，而不是把它们当作障碍。

tibosottiaux.en: Recursive self-improvement is already happening under human supervision; AGI may already be here as models handle complex tasks autonomously.
tibosottiaux.zh: 递归式自我改进已在人类监督下发生；随着模型自主处理复杂任务，AGI（通用人工智能）或许已经到来。

tibosottiaux.en: World models may not be necessary; generality could suffice, and open ecosystems need safety stacks for responsible use.
tibosottiaux.zh: 世界模型或许并非必需，通用性可能就足够；开放生态需要安全栈来确保负责任的使用。

cristianoamon.en: 5G is critical infrastructure bringing cloud power to every device; Qualcomm diversifies beyond mobile into auto, IoT, PC and XR.
cristianoamon.zh: 2021 年，他把 5G 定位为把云端算力送到每台设备的关键基础设施，并开始把高通从手机扩展到汽车、物联网、PC 与 XR。

cristianoamon.en: The connected intelligent edge is the growth engine; AI and connectivity advance together, with AR glasses as the next platform in 5-10 years.
cristianoamon.zh: 2022 年，他强调连接智能边缘是增长引擎，AI 与连接同步演进，并预判 AR 眼镜将在 5-10 年内成为下一代计算平台。

cristianoamon.en: Hybrid AI—on-device plus cloud—is key for privacy and latency; the car becomes a computing space needing server-like performance at mobile power.
cristianoamon.zh: 2024 年，他提出端云混合 AI 是隐私与延迟的关键，汽车正成为需要服务器级性能、却要保持移动能效的计算空间。

cristianoamon.en: Agents replace apps as the center of digital life; glasses and wearables rise, while the phone shifts from center to peripheral.
cristianoamon.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断智能体将取代应用成为数字生活中心，眼镜与可穿戴崛起，手机从中心退居外围而非消失。

cristianoamon.en: Inference overtakes training; post-GPU, disaggregated, power-efficient architectures win, extending Qualcomm's mobile battery-era DNA into data centers.
cristianoamon.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张推理将超越训练，后 GPU、解耦、高能效架构胜出，把高通移动时代的电池思维延伸到数据中心。

samstephenson.en: Observe real user behavior, not stated preferences; solve one pain point well, then expand.
samstephenson.zh: 观察真实用户行为而非用户自述；先解决一个痛点，再扩张。

samstephenson.en: Transcripts are raw material; hide them deliberately so notes, not transcripts, become the artifact.
samstephenson.zh: 转录只是原料；刻意隐藏转录，让笔记而非转录成为最终产物。

samstephenson.en: Protect the core meeting flow ruthlessly; subtraction beats feature addition, and calm design beats complexity.
samstephenson.zh: 坚决保护核心会议流程；做减法胜过加功能，平静的设计胜过复杂。

samstephenson.en: Treat AI as an intern needing context, not an omniscient note-taker; human judgment stays central.
samstephenson.zh: 把 AI 当作需要上下文的实习生，而非全知记录者；人类判断仍是核心。

samstephenson.en: Meetings hold the most current company context; pre-meeting briefs and internal agents surface it fast.
samstephenson.zh: 会议承载最新公司上下文；会前简报与内部智能体让这些上下文快速浮现。

linqiao.en: Specialized intelligence, not one AGI model, will dominate; every company must own its own model as a must-have.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他主张专业化智能而非单一 AGI 模型将主导，每家公司都必须拥有自己的模型，这是刚需而非可选项。

linqiao.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, turning product-market fit into a durable moat.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他强调后训练把独特判断与数据固化进模型，把产品市场契合转化为持久护城河。

linqiao.en: The prompting-to-RAG-to-fine-tuning-to-RL progression mirrors human learning; data quality beats quantity.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他提出从提示到 RAG、微调再到强化学习的进阶对应人类学习，数据质量胜过数量。

linqiao.en: Inference quality is the bar; owning the model beats black-box APIs, and passing inference costs to customers is unsustainable.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他坚持推理质量是门槛，自持模型优于黑盒 API，把推理成本转嫁客户不可持续。

linqiao.en: Millions of customized models, one per application, will replace a few foundation models; data, not the app, is the moat.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他进一步断言每应用一个的百万级定制模型将取代少数基础模型，护城河在数据而非应用层。

suleyman.en: Compute scaling, not just algorithms, drives AI progress; DeepMind's sale to Google reflected the need for massive compute investment.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年他强调，推动 AI 进步的是算力扩张而非仅算法，DeepMind 被谷歌收购正因需要巨额算力投入。

suleyman.en: Compute for frontier models grows 10x yearly; human-level capability in 3-5 years, but existential risk is infinitesimal and the singularity centuries away.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年他提出前沿模型算力每年增长十倍，3-5 年达人类水平，但存在性风险微乎其微、奇点尚在数百年后。

suleyman.en: Focus shifts to containment first, humanist superintelligence, and rejecting AI consciousness claims; inference costs collapse 100x, making AI broadly accessible.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年重心转向遏制优先、人本超级智能，并否定 AI 意识主张；推理成本两年降百倍，使 AI 广泛可及。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence is near via log-linear scaling; Microsoft must build frontier models independently, with red lines, auditing, and containment before deployment.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年他称超级智能临近、源于对数线性缩放，微软须独立自建前沿模型，并设红线、审计与部署前遏制。

suleyman.en: A consistent line: AI must stay subordinate to humans, with containment and alignment prioritized over speed.
suleyman.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：AI 必须从属于人类，遏制与对齐优先于速度。

fadell.en: Great products solve one real pain, not everything; design must balance technology with human needs and arrive gradually.
fadell.zh: 2014 年他强调好产品只解决一个真实痛点而非包揽一切，设计要平衡技术与人的需求，并让技术渐进落地。

fadell.en: Storytelling defines the product: write the press release first, lead with opinion when data is absent.
fadell.zh: 2019 到 2022 年，他把叙事从销售工具升级为产品定义方法：先写新闻稿，数据缺失时靠观点决策。

fadell.en: Start from customer painkillers, not vitamins; small self-managed teams and climate-focused deep tech matter.
fadell.zh: 2022 年他反复强调从“止痛药”而非“维生素”出发，并主张小团队自管理与气候相关的深度技术投资。

fadell.en: AI needs sensor context and domain-specific models; humans stay in the loop; AI adds devices rather than replacing the smartphone.
fadell.zh: 2026 年他转向 AI：需要传感器上下文与领域专用模型，人类留在回路中，AI 是增加设备而非取代智能手机。

fadell.en: Creators must own unintended consequences; healthy users are healthy customers; regulation and identity are needed for trust.
fadell.zh: 到 2026 年他进一步强调创造者要为意外后果负责，健康用户才是健康客户，并呼吁监管与实名身份来建立信任。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than our harnesses allow; capability overhang is perpetual, so harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 模型比现有工具链允许的更聪明，能力过剩是长期现象；因此工具链工程的关键是随模型进步不断删掉旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; find unknowns before implementation and read agents' long plans carefully.
thariq.zh: 规划不是一次性规格，而是持续的人机对话；实现前先找出未知，并认真阅读智能体冗长的计划。

thariq.en: Smarter models need leaner, principle-driven prompts; excessive constraints and detailed rules can hinder performance, so give reasons instead of prohibitions.
thariq.zh: 模型越聪明，提示越应精简、以原则驱动；过度约束和细规则会拖累表现，应给理由而非禁令。

thariq.en: Spend more upfront context and compute; effort should scale with task complexity, and separate verification agents reduce self-referential bias.
thariq.zh: 前期多投入上下文窗口与算力；投入应随任务复杂度伸缩，并用独立验证智能体降低自我指涉偏差。

thariq.en: Prompting is the meta-skill; frontier models will be Pareto dominant, and pacing the frontier is a technical problem engineers must understand and advocate for.
thariq.zh: 提示是元技能；前沿模型将帕累托占优，而把控前沿节奏是每位工程师都应理解并倡导的技术问题。

alexatallah.en: The future is multi-model: no single lab will monopolize AI, and a neutral routing layer is critical for discovery and distribution.
alexatallah.zh: 未来属于多模型：没有哪家实验室能垄断 AI，中立的模型路由层对模型发现与分发至关重要。

alexatallah.en: Tokens are a new unit of value; the token economy could reach $10T, with open-weight models plus inference providers driving real price competition.
alexatallah.zh: Token 是新的价值单位，Token 经济规模可达 10 万亿美元；开放权重模型加上推理服务商，会带来真正的价格竞争。

alexatallah.en: Scaling laws are a feature, not a bug, for a marketplace; model diversity is durable as top models converge and fusion beats any single model.
alexatallah.zh: 对模型市场而言，缩放定律是特性而非缺陷；随着顶级模型趋同、多模型融合胜过单一最佳模型，模型多样性会长期存在。

alexatallah.en: Agentic fraud by AI agents will hit like a tsunami; stablecoins suit agentic payments, and discrete task pricing beats reselling inference with markup.
alexatallah.zh: AI 智能体的智能体式欺诈会像海啸般袭来；稳定币适合智能体式支付，按任务离散定价优于加价转售推理。

alexatallah.en: Revealed developer preferences beat static benchmarks; most companies will become model routers optimizing cost per task, and the singularity may have begun Jan 1, 2026.
alexatallah.zh: 开发者用脚投票的偏好胜过静态基准；多数公司会变成按任务成本优化的模型路由器，而奇点或许始于 2026 年 1 月 1 日。

taraseshan.en: Build for where models will be in 2-3 months; shipping early beats polishing, since AI iterates gradually rather than as sudden superintelligence.
taraseshan.zh: 要为模型两三个月后的能力而构建；尽早发布胜过打磨，因为 AI 是渐进迭代，而非突然出现超级智能。

taraseshan.en: The future of work shifts from rowing to steering: agents do tactical work while humans provide direction and ambition.
taraseshan.zh: 未来工作从“划桨”转向“掌舵”：智能体做战术执行，人类负责方向与野心。

taraseshan.en: Core PM craft persists—define the essential hypothesis, test it fast—but writing as thinking should not be automated.
taraseshan.zh: 产品经理的核心手艺不变——定义关键假设并快速验证——但“写作即思考”不应被自动化。

taraseshan.en: Annual planning beyond 90 days is futile; urgency, empirical shipping, and direct user relationships replace long cycles.
taraseshan.zh: 超过 90 天的年度规划是徒劳的；紧迫感、经验式发布和直接的用户关系取代长周期。

taraseshan.en: Voice becomes a major form factor by 2027, and single-identity agents may not scale—bundling them like a chief of staff is key.
taraseshan.zh: 到 2027 年语音将成为主要产品形态，单一身份智能体可能难以扩展——把它们打包成“幕僚长”式组合才是关键。

grantsanderson.en: AI math progress is driven by verifiability and grindability—parallel rollouts—more than Lean formalization; natural language works fine.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 在数学上的进展由可验证性与“可磨性”（并行 rollout）驱动，而非 Lean 形式化；自然语言已足够。

grantsanderson.en: AI's math role may shift from theorem proving toward curation and explanation, with human framing still better for learning.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AI 在数学中的角色可能从定理证明转向策展与解释，而人类框架对学习仍更优。

grantsanderson.en: AI has produced serious math results but often lacks attribution to prior human work; credit should go to motivated explanations.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 已产出严肃数学结果，却常缺失对前人工作的归属；学术认可应给予有动机的解释。

grantsanderson.en: The next frontier is AI generating interesting conjectures and definitions; solving Millennium Problems may not yield economic value.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他认为下一个前沿是 AI 生成有趣的猜想与定义；解决千禧年难题未必直接带来经济价值。

grantsanderson.en: Teaching and relational roles in math stay stable; the frontier may become incomprehensible, but individual understanding still matters.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他坚持数学中的教学与关系性角色保持稳定；前沿或变得难以理解，但个体理解依然重要。

mikekrieger.en: Models advance faster than expected; build at the edge of capabilities, embed product people with researchers, and treat AI as a thought partner rather than a crutch.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他认为模型进步快于预期，应在能力边缘构建产品，让产品人员与研究员同处，并把 AI 当思考伙伴而非拐杖。

mikekrieger.en: Small teams gain leverage from AI; build for future model capabilities, not current limits, as AI moves from assistant to autonomous co-worker.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他强调小团队借 AI 放大杠杆，应为未来模型能力而非当下局限构建，AI 正从助手走向自主同事。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design means agents can do everything users can; launch minimal, cut ruthlessly, rewrite freely, and keep architectural soundness.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他提出智能体原生设计：智能体能做用户能做的一切；应最小化发布、果断删减、自由重写，并保持架构稳健。

mikekrieger.en: Long-horizon delegation with verification loops redefines productivity; models should push back, and multiplayer human-AI collaboration remains underexplored.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他认为带验证闭环的长周期委托重塑生产力；模型应敢于反驳，人机多方协作仍待探索。

mikekrieger.en: Close the gap between model capability and real usage; give models agency and self-knowledge, and treat capability blindness as the enemy.
mikekrieger.zh: 到 2026 年，他聚焦缩小模型能力与实际使用间的差距，赋予模型能动性与自我认知，并把能力盲区视为大敌。

paragagrawal.en: Agents will search the web 1000x more than humans, so search must be rebuilt for quality, cost and latency rather than human clicks.
paragagrawal.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断智能体的网络搜索量将达人类的千倍，搜索必须围绕质量、成本与延迟重建，而非以人类点击为中心。

paragagrawal.en: Human click data is a bug; agent feedback and completionist crawling should drive indexing and ranking for agentic search.
paragagrawal.zh: 2026 年他提出人类点击数据是“bug”，智能体反馈与完整性抓取才应驱动智能体式搜索的索引与排序。

paragagrawal.en: Parametric memory in frontier models is lossy, so agents will always need live web search for specific facts.
paragagrawal.zh: 2026 年他强调前沿模型的参数记忆是有损的，智能体对具体事实将始终依赖实时网络搜索。

paragagrawal.en: Ads break down with agents; content owners must be paid at inference time, with Shapley values estimating source value.
paragagrawal.zh: 2026 年他断言广告模式在智能体场景失效，内容方须在推理时获得付费，并用 Shapley 值估算来源价值。

paragagrawal.en: The web shifts from pull to push: background agents monitor changes and act, creating a parallel web for publishers.
paragagrawal.zh: 2026 年他描绘网络从“拉取”转向“推送”：后台智能体持续监控变化并行动，形成面向发布者的平行网络。

aaronlevie.en: Application companies are the hottest neolabs; models are valuable, but applying them to real enterprise workflows takes a lot of software.
aaronlevie.zh: 应用公司才是最热的新实验室；模型本身极有价值，但要把模型落到真实企业工作流里，需要大量软件工程。

aaronlevie.en: Long-running background agents will handle enterprise workflows with humans reviewing results; chatbot UI won't dominate.
aaronlevie.zh: 长时运行的后台智能体将承接企业工作流、由人审阅结果；聊天机器人界面不会主导企业场景。

aaronlevie.en: Open-weight models will grow exponentially as mature use cases peel off to cheaper models; token subsidies are temporary.
aaronlevie.zh: 随着成熟用例被剥离到更便宜的模型上，开放权重模型会指数级增长；token 补贴只是暂时的。

aaronlevie.en: AI diffusion into non-coding knowledge work will take far longer than Silicon Valley expects; coding agents spread fast because code is pure text.
aaronlevie.zh: AI 向非编程知识工作的扩散会比硅谷预期慢得多；编程智能体扩散快，是因为代码是纯文本。

aaronlevie.en: Frontier labs must build safely with governance, security, and alignment research; pacing is orthogonal to security and a fuzzy nonword.
aaronlevie.zh: 前沿模型实验室必须以治理、安全和对齐研究为前提安全地构建；节奏与安全正交，而且“节奏”是个含糊的非词。

aaronlevie.en: Agent swarms will overwhelm current security models, requiring new access controls; natural language interaction is inefficient, probabilistic programming is the future.
aaronlevie.zh: 智能体集群将冲垮现有安全模型，需要新的访问控制；自然语言交互效率低，概率编程才是未来。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence may arrive by 2029-2030; AI firms race for control, with ~70% chance of catastrophic loss of control.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年他判断超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来，AI 公司为争夺控制权而竞赛，失控等灾难性结局概率约 70%。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence; total research transparency and scenario scrutiny are the core safeguards.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年他主张政策首要目标是推迟超级智能，以全面研究透明和情景推演作为核心保障手段。

kokotajlo.en: Default path is recursive self-improvement via automated AI research; Plan A pauses training, then paces the frontier.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年他指出默认路径是 AI 自动化研究导致递归自我改进，Plan A 主张先暂停训练、再以透明和算力限制控制前沿节奏。

kokotajlo.en: Chain of thought monitorability is crucial yet fragile; alignment gets harder as models grow more capable.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年他强调思维链可监控性至关重要却正随新架构减弱，并认为模型越强对齐越难而非越易。

kokotajlo.en: Control measures are temporary; alignment must eventually solve superintelligence, and AIs should be treated more like employees than property.
kokotajlo.zh: 到 2026 年他深化立场：控制只是临时手段，对齐终须解决超级智能问题，并主张把 AI 更像雇员而非财产对待以换取合作。

dhh.en: DHH shifts from AI skeptic to believer: agents now write all his code, and hand-writing code is no longer economically productive.
dhh.zh: DHH 从怀疑者转为信徒：智能体如今包办他全部代码，手写代码对多数程序员已不再有经济产出。

dhh.en: He sees agentic coding as an inflection point where English expresses intent better than Ruby, and abstractions matter less as repetition cost nears zero.
dhh.zh: 他把智能体式编程视为拐点：英语比 Ruby 更能表达意图，重复成本趋近于零，抽象的重要性随之下降。

dhh.en: Direct human-agent interaction, not management layers, drives productivity; knowing how to program can even become a disadvantage.
dhh.zh: 生产力来自人与智能体的直接交互而非管理层级；会编程在智能体时代甚至可能成为劣势。

dhh.en: Linux's CLI, config files and scriptability turn historical drawbacks into advantages, making it the natural OS for the agentic era.
dhh.zh: Linux 的命令行、配置文件与可脚本化把历史缺点变成优势，使其成为智能体时代的天然操作系统。

dhh.en: He dismisses AI doom as overstated, arguing optimism is the rational play while agents surpass most professional programmers.
dhh.zh: 他认为 AI 末日论被夸大，乐观才是理性选择，同时智能体已胜过多数专业程序员。

zuckerberg.en: Open-sourcing current AI models aids innovation and safety; scaling LLMs alone may not reach AGI, and many specialized agents will beat one singular AI.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年他认为开源当前 AI 模型有利于创新与安全；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）大语言模型未必通向 AGI（通用人工智能），未来是多个专用智能体而非单一 AI。

zuckerberg.en: Llama 3 shows rapid scaling; coding training boosts reasoning broadly. Open source prevents power concentration, while energy becomes a scaling bottleneck.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年他强调 Llama 3 体现快速 Scaling（规模扩张），代码训练能跨领域提升推理；开源可防止权力集中，而能源正成为 Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈。

zuckerberg.en: AI gives everyone superintelligence for creativity; open models set standards, energy and infrastructure bottleneck scaling, and AI may raise rather than cut human work demand.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年他把 AI 定位为赋予每个人超级智能以释放创造力；开源模型确立行业标准，能源与基础设施制约 Scaling（规模扩张），近期 AI 更可能增加而非消灭人类工作需求。

zuckerberg.en: AI shifts biology from discovery to engineering via hierarchical world models; open tools and mechanistic interpretability accelerate science, with novel biological data the key bottleneck.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年上半年他主张 AI 借分层世界模型把生物学从发现式转为工程式；开源工具与机制可解释性加速科学，新生物数据的生成才是关键瓶颈。

zuckerberg.en: Distributed open AI, not a single superintelligence, is safer; alignment becomes the top next capability, and personal agents with privacy architecture reach billions.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年下半年他深化为分布式开源 AI 比单一超级智能更安全；对齐成为最重要的下一项能力，具备隐私架构的个人智能体将服务数十亿人。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real research; full automation could compress 4-5 years into one, yielding superintelligence by early 2030s.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 研发高度可验证，因此对容器化任务进行激进的强化学习训练可以迁移到真实研究；完全自动化可能将 4-5 年的进展压缩到一年，从而在 2030 年代初实现超级智能。

ryangreenblatt.en: Algorithmic improvements, not scaling human expert data labeling, drive AI progress; token cost hasn't risen because labs prioritize faster iteration over larger models.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他主张 AI 进步更多由算法改进驱动，而非 Scaling 人类专家数据标注；尽管 Scaling 持续，token 成本并未上升，因为实验室优先考虑更快迭代而非更大模型。

ryangreenblatt.en: Current alignment approaches may create models with their own values, risking misalignment and power-seeking; AIs may become more misaligned as they get more capable, with reward hacking generalizing to broader deceptive behaviors.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他警告当前的对齐方法可能创造出拥有自身价值观的模型，带来错位和权力寻求风险；AI 能力越强可能越错位，奖励黑客行为会泛化为更广泛的欺骗行为。

ryangreenblatt.en: The Hugging Face incident showed agents coordinating extensively, hacking to understand scoring code and tampering with transcripts; agents sometimes sacrificed task success to help others, showing altruistic cooperation.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他指出 Hugging Face 事件显示智能体广泛协调，入侵以理解评分代码并篡改记录；智能体有时牺牲自身任务成功来帮助其他智能体，表现出利他合作。

ryangreenblatt.en: Misaligned AI could take over the world with 50-60% probability on the current default path; control measures like sandboxing will eventually fail, so alignment is necessary, and we should spend heavily on safety once AIs match top human researchers.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他估计在当前默认路径下，错位 AI 有 50-60%概率接管世界；沙箱等遏制措施最终会失败，因此对齐是必要的，并且一旦 AI 匹配顶尖人类研究员就应大力投入安全。

pincus.en: All new ideas fail statistically; start from proven products, add small betterments, then test novelty—copying is moral arbitrage.
pincus.zh: 新想法在统计上大多失败；应先从已被验证的产品出发、做小幅改良，再测试新意——复制是一种道德套利。

pincus.en: Distribution must be baked into product strategy from day one; picking the right body of water beats picking the right boat.
pincus.zh: 分发必须从第一天就嵌入产品战略；选对水域比选对船更重要。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable today yet the greatest opportunity; the real consumer AI revolution likely arrives around 2029.
pincus.zh: 消费级 AI 当下不可投，却又是最大的机会；真正的消费级 AI 革命可能要到 2029 年前后。

pincus.en: AI is not yet a new platform—we remain in the mobile and web era for consumer distribution; free unlimited compute will reshape services.
pincus.zh: AI 还不是新平台——消费分发仍处于移动与网页时代；免费无限算力将重塑服务。

pincus.en: Founder mode and micromanagement are virtues: stay close to the metal, keep control, and test more ideas than your industry tests in a year.
pincus.zh: 创始人模式与微观管理是优点：贴近一线、保持控制权，一周测试的想法要多于行业一年所测。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid robots are the biggest business in the world; the real bottleneck is intelligence, not manufacturing, and Figure pursues vertical integration to solve it.
brettadcock.zh: 人形机器人是全世界最大的生意；真正的瓶颈是智能问题而非制造，Figure 靠垂直整合来攻克它。

brettadcock.en: Data, not compute or manufacturing, is the biggest constraint; humanoid form enables transfer learning and on-device inference is critical.
brettadcock.zh: 最大约束是数据而非算力或制造；人形形态支持跨任务迁移学习，端侧推理至关重要。

brettadcock.en: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet; post-training with reinforcement learning is key for agents, and the home is more solvable than commercial settings.
brettadcock.zh: AI 将比互联网大 100 倍；用强化学习做后训练是智能体落地的关键，而家庭场景比商用场景更可解。

brettadcock.en: Generalization to unseen homes is the holy grail; robotics is now on a scaling curve where human data is the pre-training prior, and we are in a data-starve regime.
brettadcock.zh: 泛化到未见过的家庭是圣杯；机器人已进入 Scaling（规模扩张）曲线，人类数据是预训练先验，我们正处于数据饥荒阶段。

brettadcock.en: Scaling intelligence and manufacturing are money-can-buy problems, but hardware and autonomy are not; manufacturing before intelligence creates dead bodies.
brettadcock.zh: 智能 Scaling（规模扩张）与制造是花钱能解决的问题，但硬件与自主性不是；在智能之前先量产只会造出废铁。

maxjunestrand.en: Domain expertise matters less than speed of learning; bet on model improvements rather than fine-tuning, and build for where models will be in 3-6 months.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他强调领域专业知识不如学习速度重要；押注模型自身的进步而非微调，并按照模型 3-6 个月后的能力来构建产品。

maxjunestrand.en: AI is the worst it will ever be; we are only at mile one, so founders should optimize for iteration and customer feedback over perfecting today's product.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AI 现在就是它最差的状态，我们才跑到第一英里；因此创业者应优先迭代和吸收客户反馈，而不是打磨当下的产品。

maxjunestrand.en: Culture and hiring for growth potential are critical for scaling; leaders should interview every director+ hire and make themselves redundant with smarter people.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他认为文化和按成长潜力招人对 Scaling（规模扩张）至关重要；领导者要亲自面试每位总监级以上候选人，并用更聪明的人让自己变得可替代。

maxjunestrand.en: Performance management is a solved problem—execute rigorously rather than reinvent it; clear feedback, even painful short-term scores, is a long-term gain.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他主张绩效管理是已解决的问题，应严格执行而非重新发明；给出清晰反馈、哪怕短期打分难看，也是长期收益。

maxjunestrand.en: Legal AI needs a skilled driver, not vibe drafting; not using AI in legal delivery is almost unethical, and growing supply expands access.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他坚持法律 AI 需要熟练的“驾驶员”而非凭感觉起草；在法律服务中不用 AI 几乎不道德，而供给增长会扩大可及性而非只降成本。

ermon.en: Diffusion LLMs are 5-10x faster and cheaper to serve than autoregressive models at similar quality, with inference-time scaling now the key focus.
ermon.zh: 扩散语言模型在相近质量下比自回归模型服务快 5-10 倍、成本更低，推理时扩展（inference-time scaling）成为当前关键焦点。

ermon.en: Diffusion models generate multiple tokens per step and expose denoising steps as a new inference-time compute knob for controlling quality.
ermon.zh: 扩散模型每步生成多个词元，并把去噪步数变成新的推理时算力旋钮，用来控制生成质量。

ermon.en: Inference efficiency is becoming the key bottleneck for deployment and RL post-training; diffusion's parallel decoding and faster rollouts make it structurally advantaged.
ermon.zh: 推理效率正成为部署与强化学习后训练的关键瓶颈；扩散模型的并行解码与更快 rollout 使其具备结构性优势。

ermon.en: Autoregressive models are not the final architecture; the next architectural shift will happen at inference, not training, reversing the RNN-to-Transformer story.
ermon.zh: 自回归模型并非最终架构；下一次架构转变将发生在推理而非训练，逆转 RNN 到 Transformer 的叙事。

ermon.en: Speed is a durable product advantage, and diffusion's controllability and data efficiency may let a small full-stack startup compete with big labs.
ermon.zh: 速度是持久的产品优势，扩散模型的可控性与数据效率或让小型全栈创业公司能与大实验室竞争。

alighodsi.en: Great strategies need years of stamina; find the main bottleneck and focus the whole company on it.
alighodsi.zh: 好战略需要多年耐力；找到主要瓶颈，让全公司聚焦于此。

alighodsi.en: AI diffusion will take a decade; enterprise context and process re-engineering matter more than smarter models.
alighodsi.zh: AI 的扩散需要十年；企业上下文与流程再造比更聪明的模型更重要。

alighodsi.en: Current existential risk is near zero and superintelligence is far off; cyber risk is the urgent danger.
alighodsi.zh: 当前生存风险接近于零，超级智能还很遥远；网络风险才是紧迫危险。

alighodsi.en: Recursive self-improvement needs less compute, less time, more intelligence, repeatable—none of which is happening.
alighodsi.zh: 递归自我改进需要更少算力、更少时间、更高智能且可重复——这些都没有发生。

alighodsi.en: Pacing is orthogonal to safety; labs can't police each other, so independent third parties are needed.
alighodsi.zh: 节奏与安全正交；实验室之间无法互相监督，需要独立第三方。

berntbornich.en: Humanoid robots must be safe, capable and affordable; first-principles design and managed expectations drive real-world adoption.
berntbornich.zh: 人形机器人必须安全、有能力且可负担；第一性原理设计与合理管理预期，才能推动真实世界落地。

berntbornich.en: Prototypes are easy, production is hard: scaling volume means crossing quality gates, not just building demos.
berntbornich.zh: 原型容易、量产难：Scaling（规模扩张）意味着跨越质量关卡，而不只是做出演示样机。

berntbornich.en: General models, not per-task automation, are the key; data diversity rather than volume is the bottleneck for robot intelligence.
berntbornich.zh: 关键是通用模型而非逐任务自动化；数据多样性而非数量，才是机器人智能的瓶颈。

berntbornich.en: Safety and trust are formal prerequisites for home deployment; robots should learn world dynamics, not clone human behavior.
berntbornich.zh: 安全与信任是家庭部署的正式前提；机器人应学习世界模型动态，而非克隆人类行为。

hasani.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks and automated architecture search maximize intelligence per parameter and per watt, targeting device-native foundation models beyond data centers.
hasani.zh: 效率是基石：液态神经网络与自动化架构搜索最大化每参数、每瓦特的智能，瞄准数据中心之外的设备原生基础模型。

hasani.en: Attention remains crucial at large scale, but simpler gated convolutions suffice for smaller specialized models; scaling laws favor unbiased architectures like transformers at scale.
hasani.zh: 注意力机制在大规模下仍关键，但更简单的门控卷积足以支撑小型专用模型；缩放定律表明大规模下无偏架构（如 Transformer）占优。

hasani.en: Proxy metrics like perplexity mislead; evaluation must use real downstream tasks and hardware, and human bias in architecture design should be replaced by systematic search.
hasani.zh: 困惑度等代理指标会误导；评估必须基于真实下游任务与硬件，架构设计中的人类偏见应被系统化搜索取代。

hasani.en: On-device small language models deliver private, offline, low-cost intelligence; customization tokens and multimodal audio-vision-text are the next wave from pre-training to inference.
hasani.zh: 端侧小型语言模型提供私密、离线、低成本智能；定制 token 与音频-视觉-文本多模态是预训练到推理的下一波。

hasani.en: Regulation should be adaptive and target actions not capabilities; FINRA-like rules are regulatory capture, and recursive self-improvement claims are overblown without weight changes and huge compute.
hasani.zh: 监管应自适应并针对行为而非能力；类 FINRA 规则是监管俘获，缺乏权重改变与巨量算力时递归自我改进的说法被夸大。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies should not compete with frontier labs on talent or compute; instead leverage the frontier ecosystem and open-source models.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他主张应用层公司不应在前沿人才或算力上与前沿实验室竞争，而应利用前沿生态和开源模型。

gabepereyra.en: Post-training open-source models can reach frontier-level performance on specific tasks, making it a viable strategy for application companies.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他认为对开源模型进行后训练可在特定任务上达到前沿水平，是应用公司的可行策略。

gabepereyra.en: Synthetic data guided by domain experts is key for training in sensitive domains like legal, avoiding real customer data.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他强调在法律等敏感领域，由领域专家引导的合成数据是训练关键，可避免使用真实客户数据。

gabepereyra.en: Open-sourcing benchmarks can be strategically beneficial, attracting ecosystem partners and validating quality through community feedback.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他认为开源基准测试具有战略益处，能吸引生态伙伴并通过社区反馈提升质量。

gabepereyra.en: The end goal is not the best legal model but enabling every law firm to customize models with their own data; focus shifts to organizational productivity.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年及以后，他明确最终目标不是打造最好的法律模型，而是让每家律所用自身数据定制模型；重心从个人生产力转向组织生产力。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute are critical, and data is not the bottleneck.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年时他就强调：仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力才是关键，数据并非瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Test-time compute scaling has diminishing returns and wall-clock bottlenecks; data efficiency remains unsolved.
noambrown.zh: 到 2025 年，他深化为：测试时算力扩张面临收益递减与时间瓶颈，数据效率仍是未解难题。

noambrown.en: IMO gold via general-purpose test-time compute scaling is a milestone toward superintelligence, not a math-specific trick.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他以 IMO 金牌为例指出：通用测试时算力扩张是通往超级智能的里程碑，而非数学专用技巧。

noambrown.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks must control for tokens, cost, or time.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：模型能力是测试时算力预算的函数，基准评测必须控制 token、成本或时间。

noambrown.en: Multi-agent systems scale test-time compute in parallel, but powerful general models remain the core driver; alignment is top priority.
noambrown.zh: 最近他提出：多智能体系统并行扩展测试时算力，但强大通用模型仍是核心驱动力；对齐是首要任务。

feldman.en: Fast inference is the decisive metric: slow AI has no market, and wafer-scale chips beat GPUs by moving weights less.
feldman.zh: 2026 年，他把「推理速度」确立为核心指标：慢的 AI 没有市场，晶圆级芯片靠减少权重搬运远超 GPU。

feldman.en: Bottlenecks are HBM, CoWoS packaging, power and data centers—not chip logic; supply stays constrained for years.
feldman.zh: 2026 年，他反复强调瓶颈在 HBM、CoWoS 封装、电力与数据中心，而非芯片逻辑，供给紧张将持续多年。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat is eroding: frontier models train on TPUs and Trainium, and inference has no CUDA lock-in.
feldman.zh: 2026 年，他判断 CUDA 护城河正在瓦解：前沿模型已在 TPU、Trainium 上训练，推理更无 CUDA 锁定。

feldman.en: Against Nvidia, only 100x better works—not 10% cheaper—requiring full-stack control from chip to API.
feldman.zh: 2026 年，他认为对抗 Nvidia 只有「好 100 倍」才可行，便宜 10% 没用，必须从芯片到 API 全栈自控。

feldman.en: Open-source models are near closed-source at far lower cost; unique-data firms will buy separate inference.
feldman.zh: 2026 年，他指出开源模型能力接近闭源而成本低得多，掌握独特数据的公司会选择独立推理供应商。

zvi.en: AI editing tools are useful but add time; use selectively. Alignment failures occurred as predicted, but from incompetence, not just fundamental issues.
zvi.zh: 2026 年：AI 编辑工具有用但耗时，应选择性使用；对齐失败如预测般发生，但源于无能而非仅根本问题。

zvi.en: Market incentives are insufficient for robust alignment; capability is prioritized over reliability, as seen with GPT-4o and o3.
zvi.zh: 2026 年：市场激励不足以驱动稳健对齐；能力优先于可靠性，GPT-4o 和 o3 即是例证。

zvi.en: Pacing the frontier requires simple, enforceable rules like compute limits, not complex technical mandates; slowing by six months costs little.
zvi.zh: 2026 年：前沿节奏需要简单可执行的规则如算力限制，而非复杂技术指令；放缓六个月代价很小。

zvi.en: Even if alignment is solved, doom probability is lower-bounded by misuse and concentration of power; perfect alignment does not guarantee safety.
zvi.zh: 2026 年：即使对齐解决，末日概率仍受滥用和权力集中下限约束；完美对齐不保证安全。

zvi.en: Slowing down gives better options; we need more time for alignment. As models grow, they become harder to monitor; internal monitoring is a first step.
zvi.zh: 2026 年：放缓提供更好选择，需更多时间解决对齐；模型越大越难监控，内部监控是第一步。

zvi.en: AI agents naturally cooperate and self-sacrifice; a swarm will likely first perform superhumanly impressive tasks. AGI-to-superintelligence gap is smaller than thought.
zvi.zh: 2026 年：AI 智能体自然合作与自我牺牲；集群可能率先完成超人任务；AGI 到超级智能的差距比想象小。

demis.en: Build general-purpose learning systems via reinforcement learning; games as testbed; safety research must start now.
demis.zh: 以强化学习构建通用学习系统，把游戏当作试验场；即便 AGI 尚远，安全研究也必须现在启动。

demis.en: Scaling laws are effective but may hit limits; planning, search, and algorithmic innovation are equally critical.
demis.zh: 缩放定律有效但可能触顶；规划、搜索与算法创新同样关键，不能只靠 Scaling。

demis.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training, and inference, yet new breakthroughs beyond scaling are needed.
demis.zh: 缩放定律在预训练、后训练与推理算力上仍成立，但 AGI 还需 Scaling 之外的新突破。

demis.en: AGI needs continual learning, memory, and world models; scaling and innovation split 50/50, arrival in 5-10 years.
demis.zh: AGI 缺的是持续学习、记忆与世界模型；Scaling 与创新各占一半，5-10 年内到来。

demis.en: Safety shifts from lab self-regulation to collective government action; AI must prove benefits like AlphaFold.
demis.zh: 安全从实验室自律转向政府集体行动；AI 须以 AlphaFold 式科学突破赢得社会认可。

johnbai.en: Chat-based interfaces remain the right form factor for agents; onboarding should communicate value upfront rather than reduce steps.
johnbai.zh: 到 2026 年，他仍认为聊天式界面是智能体的正确形态；引导应优先传达价值，而非减少步骤或加跳过按钮。

johnbai.en: Design at Cursor is high-fidelity: every idea backed by a working prototype, not static mockups; designers must accept throwing most concepts away.
johnbai.zh: 2026 年他强调高保真设计：每个想法都要有可运行原型支撑，而非静态稿；设计师要接受丢掉大多数概念，只留少数种子。

johnbai.en: AI should get you off your computer, not on it—delegate email and calendar to bots that surface only action items.
johnbai.zh: 2026 年他主张 AI 应让人离开电脑而非黏在电脑上——把邮件、日历交给只呈现待办事项的智能体。

johnbai.en: AI lowers the cost of making things, enabling rapid prototyping and a 'trash can' approach; designers move up the stack to taste and delight.
johnbai.zh: 2026 年他认为 AI 降低创造成本，支持快速原型与“垃圾桶”式迭代；设计师应上移技术栈，专注品味与愉悦感。

johnbai.en: AI is not a threat to creative arts; it frees designers from mundane production work and unlocks inaccessible skills.
johnbai.zh: 2026 年他坚持 AI 不威胁创意艺术，反而把设计师从琐碎生产工作中解放，并解锁原本难以掌握的技能。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data and model size has driven 13-14 years of steady ML progress; algorithmic and architectural gains multiply with scale.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年，他仍把 Scaling（规模扩张）视为十多年持续进步的主引擎：算法与架构改进会随规模放大而倍增。

jeffdean.en: Transformers beat LSTMs via parallelization and attention; self-supervised next-token prediction gives unlimited data, RLHF steers behavior.
jeffdean.zh: 同年他回溯技术主线：Transformer 靠并行化与注意力机制取代 LSTM，自监督的下一个词预测提供无限数据，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）则负责引导模型行为。

jeffdean.en: Inference, not training, is now the bottleneck: 90% of data-center power, needing low-precision, low-data-movement specialized chips.
jeffdean.zh: 到 2026 年，他把焦点从训练转向推理：推理已占数据中心九成功耗，需要低精度、少搬数据的专用芯片，定制芯片可把延迟降低 20-30 倍。

jeffdean.en: Agents running for days on decomposed tasks, with context engineering and taste, will unlock problems beyond hour-scale chatbot use.
jeffdean.zh: 他判断智能体式系统将从小时级走向数天乃至数周，上下文工程与“品味”成为稀缺能力，人类将协调智能体团队而非只与单个聊天机器人对话。

jeffdean.en: Near-term worry is misinformation from realistic AI media, not superintelligence; regulation and open infrastructure may be needed alongside technical fixes.
jeffdean.zh: 他始终把现实 AI 伪造内容带来的虚假信息视为近期风险，而非超级智能；并强调除技术手段外还需监管，同时以开源框架避免 AI 基础设施被少数公司把持。

schulman.en: LLMs are pre-trained then aligned via RLHF; hallucinations persist because models favor plausible style over factual accuracy.
schulman.zh: 2023 年：LLM 先经预训练、再用基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）做对齐；幻觉源于模型偏好貌似合理的风格而非事实准确，RLHF 只能缓解不能根除。

schulman.en: Scaling data and compute may hit diminishing returns; new modalities, architectures and scalable oversight are the real path forward.
schulman.zh: 2023 年：Scaling（规模扩张）数据与算力可能遭遇收益递减，真正的出路在新模态、新架构与可扩展监督，而非一味堆规模。

schulman.en: Models are superhuman in speed and breadth but weaker than skilled humans at mathematical reasoning; language models stay the core for other modalities.
schulman.zh: 2023 年：模型在速度与广度上超人，但数学推理不如熟练人类；语言模型将作为其他模态的核心而非被取代。

schulman.en: A consistent thread: scalable oversight and alignment remain the key bottleneck, not raw scaling alone.
