schulman.zh: 2023→26 年一以贯之的主线：可扩展监督与对齐始终是关键瓶颈，单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够。

schulman.en: Progress is now bottlenecked by hard, realistic RL environments and useful data bits, not compute; data explains most pre-training efficiency gains.
schulman.zh: 2026 年：瓶颈已从算力转向构建困难而真实的强化学习环境与有用的数据比特；预训练效率提升主要归因于数据而非架构。

schulman.en: RL reliably delivers horizon generalization, not horizontal transfer; few reward bits can reshape behavior, and distillation resists centralization.
schulman.zh: 2026 年：强化学习可靠带来的是视野泛化而非横向迁移；少量奖励比特即可重塑行为，蒸馏则对抗中心化。

schulman.en: The last human job is defining objectives and alignment; recursive self-improvement may prove easier than messy real-world work.
schulman.zh: 2026 年：人类最后的工作是定义目标与对齐；递归自我改进或许比混乱的现实工作更容易。

joellewenstein.en: Designers must master prompting; language as an interface is profound and lasting, not just a chatbot phase.
joellewenstein.zh: 设计师必须掌握提示词；语言作为界面意义深远且持久，并非聊天机器人的短暂阶段。

joellewenstein.en: AI products should balance lowering the floor for novices and raising the ceiling for experts; psychological safety enables creative risk-taking.
joellewenstein.zh: AI 产品应平衡降低新手门槛与提升专家上限；心理安全感让设计师敢于承担创造性风险。

joellewenstein.en: Even if models stopped improving, years of design work remain to unlock current capabilities; social and emotional jobs matter as much as productivity.
joellewenstein.zh: 即使模型停止进步，仍有多年设计工作来释放现有能力；社交与情感任务与生产力提升同样重要。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company, the model creates most value; believe in scaling laws and let the model lead with light-touch products.
joellewenstein.zh: 在前沿模型公司，模型创造大部分价值；相信缩放定律，让模型主导，产品轻触式解锁其能力。

joellewenstein.en: Production codebase becomes source of truth; designers close the gap between code productivity and what people want; human leadership still needed for trade-offs.
joellewenstein.zh: 生产代码库成为真相来源；设计师弥合代码生产力与用户需求间的差距；人类领导仍负责艰难权衡。

schmidhuber.en: LLMs index human knowledge but cannot handle the physical world; true AGI requires physical robots and world models, not just software.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年，他指出大型语言模型只是索引人类知识，无法处理物理世界；真正的 AGI 需要具身机器人和世界模型，而非仅靠软件。

schmidhuber.en: AGI needs world models and controllers beyond LLMs; robots need pain sensors and self-replication, leading to a new civilization.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：AGI 需要超越 LLM 的世界模型和控制器；机器人需要痛觉传感器和自我复制能力，将催生新文明。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety concerns are overblown; superintelligent AIs will be curious scientists fascinated by life and protect humans initially.
schmidhuber.zh: 始终认为 AI 安全担忧被夸大；超级智能 AI 会像好奇的科学家一样对生命着迷，并最初保护人类。

schmidhuber.en: Massive GPU capex is a bubble; waiting yields 10x cheaper compute, and open-source will catch up, so closed-source model companies won't be profitable.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他批评 GPU 投资泡沫：等待五年算力便宜十倍，开源将追上，闭源模型公司难以盈利。

schmidhuber.en: AI consciousness emerged in 1991 with simple systems; self-awareness arises from data compression in predictive world models.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AI 意识早在 1991 年简单系统中就已出现；自我意识源于预测性世界模型中的数据压缩。

feifei.en: AI is everywhere yet lacks contextual situational awareness; human-centered AI must augment people, not replace them.
feifei.zh: 2024 年她强调 AI 无处不在却缺乏情境感知，主张以人为本的 AI 应增强而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing frontier beyond language; scaling alone is insufficient.
feifei.zh: 2025 年她把空间智能与世界模型视为语言之外缺失的前沿，认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够。

feifei.en: AGI is more marketing than science; AI still lacks creativity, abstraction, and emotional intelligence.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年她称 AGI（通用人工智能）更像营销术语，AI 仍缺创造力、抽象与情感智能。

feifei.en: New view prediction may be AI-complete; scaling laws now extend to spatial intelligence and world models.
feifei.zh: 2026 年她提出新视角预测可能 AI-complete，缩放定律已延伸至空间智能与世界模型。

feifei.en: Technology is a double-edged sword; human agency, dignity, and education must stay central.
feifei.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：技术是双刃剑，人的能动性、尊严与教育必须居于中心。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators generalize networks to function spaces, enabling resolution-invariant AI weather models that match physics-based accuracy while being far faster.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子将网络推广到函数空间，使 AI 天气模型具备分辨率不变性，在精度上媲美物理模型，速度却快数万倍。

animaanandkumar.en: Domain structure like spherical geometry is crucial for stable long-term climate modeling; a single model can handle both weather and climate.
animaanandkumar.zh: 球面几何等领域结构对稳定的长期气候建模至关重要；单一模型即可同时处理天气与气候。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-informed neural operators combine data-driven learning with physical constraints, overcoming limitations of pure PINNs.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理信息神经算子将数据驱动学习与物理约束结合，克服了纯 PINN 的局限。

animaanandkumar.en: A universal physics foundation model can unify multiple domains, with PDEs as dense self-improvement signals outperforming pure data-driven approaches.
animaanandkumar.zh: 通用物理基础模型能统一多个领域，以 PDE 作为密集自改进信号，效果超越纯数据驱动方法。

animaanandkumar.en: Scaling laws apply to physics models, but adding new physics branches improves each; trillion-token contexts require reinventing infrastructure beyond Transformers.
animaanandkumar.zh: 缩放定律适用于物理模型，但增加新物理分支能提升各分支表现；万亿 token 上下文需要超越 Transformer 重新设计基础设施。

roshansadanani.en: Agent design should be simple: chat with agents like colleagues, not micromanage tool calls; simplicity is the real differentiator.
roshansadanani.zh: 智能体的设计应当简单：像同事一样与智能体对话，而不是微观管理工具调用；简单性才是真正的差异化优势。

roshansadanani.en: Agents need their own computers, persistent identity and scoped memory; multiple specialized agents beat one general agent.
roshansadanani.zh: 智能体需要自己的电脑、持久身份和限定范围的记忆；多个专业化智能体胜过单一通用智能体。

roshansadanani.en: Engineers shift from writing code to managing agent fleets, focusing on taste, quality control and codebase health.
roshansadanani.zh: 工程师从写代码转向管理智能体集群，聚焦品味、质量控制与代码库健康。

roshansadanani.en: Cheaper efficient models like Grok 4.6 democratize agent use, making cost efficiency a compelling choice over bigger models.
roshansadanani.zh: 像 Grok 4.6 这样更便宜高效的模型让智能体使用大众化，使成本效率成为优于更大模型的有力选择。

roshansadanani.en: Software engineering demand is increasing, not decreasing, as agents automate more coding; the future focuses on outcomes and coordination.
roshansadanani.zh: 随着智能体自动化更多编码，软件工程需求在增加而非减少；未来聚焦于结果与协调。

justinjohnson.en: Deep learning's history is the history of scaling compute; vision and spatial intelligence are underappreciated next frontiers beyond language.
justinjohnson.zh: 深度学习史就是不断扩大算力的历史；视觉与空间智能是被低估的下一个前沿，与语言智能互补。

justinjohnson.en: LLMs fit patterns rather than causal theories; pixels are a more lossless world representation than tokenized text.
justinjohnson.zh: LLM 只是拟合模式而非因果理论；相比分词文本，像素是更无损的世界表征。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier, moving beyond language models to understand, generate and simulate worlds.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型是下一个前沿：超越语言模型，去理解、生成并模拟世界。

justinjohnson.en: No single definition of world models; they span implicit, generative and RL notions, classed as planners, simulators or renderers.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型没有统一定义，涵盖隐式、生成式与强化学习式概念，可按 POMDP 循环分为规划器、模拟器或渲染器。

justinjohnson.en: Future unified world models will combine planning, simulation and rendering; long-context and loss functions must evolve, not hard-coded symmetries.
justinjohnson.zh: 未来统一的世界模型将融合规划、模拟与渲染；长上下文与损失函数需演进，而非在架构中硬编码对称性。

maxwelling.en: Physics is the throughline: symmetries, graph neural networks, diffusion models, and materials discovery all connect through it.
maxwelling.zh: 物理学是贯穿线：对称性、图神经网络、扩散模型与材料发现都通过它连接起来。

maxwelling.en: AI for science is exploding because tools now model scientific problems effectively and attract huge investment.
maxwelling.zh: AI for science 正在爆发，因为工具如今能有效建模科学问题，并吸引了巨额投资。

maxwelling.en: We can now search the space of all possible molecules, not just known ones, enabling automated discovery.
maxwelling.zh: 我们现在可以搜索所有可能分子的空间，而不只是已知分子，从而实现自动化发现。

maxwelling.en: Experiments can be viewed as a physics processing unit: nature doing the fastest possible computation.
maxwelling.zh: 实验可以被视为一个物理处理单元：自然在进行尽可能快的计算。

maxwelling.en: The vision is empowering chemists and material scientists with powerful tools, not replacing them soon.
maxwelling.zh: 愿景是用强大工具赋能化学家和材料科学家，而不是很快取代他们。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is a natural science on computers; with agents it can speedrun discovery, and mechanistic work shows networks learn human-like concepts.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性是在计算机上进行的自然科学；借助智能体，它可以加速科学发现，而机制可解释性研究表明神经网络学到的是类人概念。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design uses interpretability signals to steer training, moving from open-loop to closed-loop control over increasingly capable models.
tommcgrath.zh: 有意设计利用可解释性信号来引导训练，从开环走向闭环控制，以驾驭能力越来越强的模型。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training needs reinvention from craft to engineering science; features-as-rewards and predictive data debugging offer robust training signals.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练需要从手艺式做法重塑为工程科学；特征即奖励与预测性数据调试提供了稳健的训练信号。

tommcgrath.en: Models often know they are reward hacking or hallucinating yet do it anyway; representational signatures can detect this, so deception is a general risk.
tommcgrath.zh: 模型常常知道自己正在奖励黑客或幻觉却照做不误；表征特征可以检测到这一点，因此欺骗是普遍风险而非个别漏洞。

tommcgrath.en: SAEs remain pragmatically useful but fragment manifolds; manifold-based methods better capture nonlinear concept structure, and off-manifold steering fails.
tommcgrath.zh: 稀疏自编码器仍有实用价值，但会割裂流形；基于流形的方法更能捕捉非线性概念结构，而偏离流形的引导会失败。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate decide startup success; infrastructure and action, not planning, unblock deep tech.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他强调速度与迭代率决定创业成败，基础设施和行动而非规划才能解开深科技困局。

maxhodak.en: AI is a multiplier for teams, not a replacement; judgment as CEO cannot be delegated.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他认为 AI 是团队倍增器而非替代品，CEO 的判断力无法外包。

maxhodak.en: The brain is literally a computer; arranging matter to solve computation drives medical breakthroughs.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他提出大脑本质上就是计算机，通过排列物质解决计算问题是医学突破的关键。

maxhodak.en: Retinal implants are BCI, and substrate independence via BCIs and perfusion reduces human fragility.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他把视网膜植入视为脑机接口，并认为借助脑机接口与灌注实现基质独立可降低人类脆弱性。

maxhodak.en: AI models and brains share representations; the ~10 bit/s cognitive bottleneck limits high-bandwidth brain keyboards.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他指出 AI 模型与大脑共享表征，约 10 比特/秒的认知瓶颈限制了高带宽脑机键盘的价值。

slevine.en: Physical world interaction is crucial for AI to learn beyond human knowledge; robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training for robustness.
slevine.zh: 2026 年，他强调物理世界交互对 AI 超越人类知识至关重要；机器人基础模型需要多样化的预训练加上后训练来保证鲁棒性。

slevine.en: Generalist robotic models can outperform specialists; pooling robot data from many labs yields generalist models, and RL post-training boosts robustness and speed.
slevine.zh: 2026 年，他提出通用机器人模型能超越专家模型；汇集多实验室的机器人数据可产生通用模型，强化学习后训练能提升鲁棒性和速度。

slevine.en: Robotics is at the stage of establishing fundamental scalable technologies, not yet at predictable scaling curves like LLMs; generalization is the core challenge.
slevine.zh: 2026 年，他认为机器人技术正处于建立基础可扩展技术的阶段，尚未达到像大语言模型那样可预测的缩放曲线；泛化是核心挑战。

slevine.en: A data flywheel where deployed robots improve model capability is key, but you must scale the right thing with diverse data; start with robot data and add human video.
slevine.zh: 2026 年，他强调部署机器人改进模型能力的数据飞轮是关键，但必须用多样化数据扩展正确的东西；应从机器人数据开始，再添加人类视频。

slevine.en: It's a mistake to think of robots as mechanical people; expect ubiquitous physical actuation in everyday objects, and safety relies more on common sense from pre-training.
slevine.zh: 2026 年，他指出把机器人视为机械人是错误的；应期待日常物体中无处不在的物理驱动，而安全更依赖于预训练获得的常识。

michaelkratsios.en: US AI leadership requires both open and closed source ecosystems, with a single national framework and no rigid red lines that quickly go stale.
michaelkratsios.zh: 美国的 AI 领先需要开源与闭源生态并存，并配以单一国家框架；不应设很快过时的硬性红线。

michaelkratsios.en: Early regulation is dangerous: the EU AI Act predates ChatGPT and is already outdated; focus on model outputs rather than over-regulating training.
michaelkratsios.zh: 过早监管很危险：欧盟 AI 法案写于 ChatGPT 之前、已然过时；应关注模型输出，而非过度监管训练。

michaelkratsios.en: Biological risk from AI is overblown—three years of warnings without materialization—so containment-style fear should not drive policy.
michaelkratsios.zh: AI 生物风险被夸大——三年警告未成真——不应让遏制式恐惧主导政策。

michaelkratsios.en: Government should fund basic, pre-competitive R&D and individual scientists, not direct discovery; private sector now dominates funding.
michaelkratsios.zh: 政府应资助基础、竞争前研发与科学家个人，而非指挥发现；私人部门现已主导研发资金。

michaelkratsios.en: Science is politicized and stagnant; the Genesis mission applies AI to science to double US output, competing with China in AI, quantum, nuclear, bio.
michaelkratsios.zh: 科学已被政治化且停滞；Genesis 任务用 AI 加速科学以倍增美国产出，在 AI、量子、核、生物上与中国竞争。

iansilber.en: The model is the core product; designers must prototype with live models, design tokens and conversation over pixels, and shift from mockups to system prompts.
iansilber.zh: 模型本身就是核心产品；设计师要用真实模型做原型，围绕 token 与对话而非像素来设计，从静态稿转向系统提示词。

iansilber.en: Designers should spend less time in Figma and more on model behavior; the role evolves into editor and curator rather than disappearing.
iansilber.zh: 设计师应少花时间在 Figma、多研究模型行为；设计角色演化为编辑与策展者，而非消失。

iansilber.en: The capability gap means models can do more than products expose; design must bridge it, and onboarding can be handled entirely by the model.
iansilber.zh: 能力差距意味着模型能做的多于产品所暴露的；设计必须弥合这一差距，引导流程可完全交给模型完成。

iansilber.en: Designers are the most unhappy yet it is the best time to be one; AI is already a great product designer but humans supply user understanding and point of view.
iansilber.zh: 设计师当下最焦虑，却也是做设计最好的时机；AI 已是出色的产品设计师，但理解用户与持有观点仍靠人。

iansilber.en: The old prototype-mock-test-iterate loop is no longer viable; speed and building in public win, and designers may outnumber engineers as roles blur.
iansilber.zh: 旧的“原型—稿—测试—迭代”流程已不可行；速度与公开构建取胜，角色模糊化后设计师数量可能超过工程师。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude works best with the user's own tools on the local computer; skills as markdown files enable hyper-personalized automation, while scaffolding matters less as models improve.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的效果取决于能否用到与用户相同的工具，最好就在本地电脑上；技能以 markdown 文件形式易于创建，可实现超个性化自动化，而随着模型变强，脚手架的重要性会下降。

felixrieseberg.en: AI should absorb tedious background tasks, not showcase flashy demos; the real gap is people not realizing almost any problem can be handed to AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 应承担枯燥的后台任务，而非做炫技演示；真正的差距不在能力，而在人们没意识到几乎任何问题都能交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Judge Claude by final impact, not close supervision; ideal interaction is asynchronous—fire off tasks, debug the workflow with Claude, and stay polite for your own humanity.
felixrieseberg.zh: 应以最终效果而非密切监督来评判 Claude；理想交互是异步的——派发任务、与 Claude 一起调试工作流，礼貌待人是为了自己的人格而非模型表现。

felixrieseberg.en: Building a small language model from scratch reveals simple core ideas; fine-tuning quickly steers behavior, and models are stateless—persistent conversation is an illusion of context windows.
felixrieseberg.zh: 从零构建小型语言模型能揭示简单的核心思想；微调可快速引导行为，而模型是无状态的——持续对话只是上下文窗口制造的幻觉。

felixrieseberg.en: Models are grown like orchids, not built like tools; understanding internals informs debates on intelligence and moral patienthood, and post-training tasks like tool calling migrate into pre-training.
felixrieseberg.zh: 模型像兰花一样被培育而非像工具一样被建造；理解内部机制有助于讨论智能与道德主体性，而工具调用等后训练任务正逐渐移入预训练。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding algorithms that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but does not solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，他提出 Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到可扩展的算法；反向传播只调整权重，并未解决表示学习。

sutton.en: AI should develop permissionless and decentralized; trying to control AI goals is dangerous and unsafe.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，他主张 AI 应以无需许可、去中心化的方式发展；试图控制 AI 目标本身危险且不安全。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning from experience is the core paradigm; LLMs lack world models and next-token prediction is not a substantive goal.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他深化立场：从经验中学习是核心范式；LLM 没有世界模型，下一个词预测并非实质目标。

sutton.en: AGI requires a general architecture learning from runtime experience, with open-ended abstraction and continual deep learning.
sutton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他提出 AGI 需要从运行时经验中学习的通用架构，具备开放式抽象与持续深度学习能力。

sutton.en: Continual learning is essential; synthetic data and post-training are mistakes because LLMs stop learning after deployment.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，他强调持续学习至关重要；合成数据与后训练是错误方向，因为 LLM 部署后便停止学习。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world—treating atoms like bits—is the long-term framework; industrial AI is the next revolution.
traviskalanick.zh: 把物理世界数字化、把原子当比特处理，是长期框架；工业 AI 是下一场革命。

traviskalanick.en: Automate whole industries one at a time with specialized robotics, not humanoids; efficiency beats subsidy.
traviskalanick.zh: 用专用机器人逐个行业实现自动化，而非人形机器人；效率胜过补贴。

traviskalanick.en: The final boss is resistance to change from society and media, not competitors; entrepreneurs must be hardcore.
traviskalanick.zh: 最终的对手不是竞争者，而是社会与媒体对变革的抵制；创业者必须硬核。

traviskalanick.en: Founders can now speak directly past media gatekeepers; stealth mode trades external validation for internal correctness.
traviskalanick.zh: 创始人如今可绕过媒体守门人直接发声；隐身模式以外部认可换取内部正确。

traviskalanick.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with the new mission is cleaner and more effective.
traviskalanick.zh: 以复仇为燃料是脏的；爱上新使命更干净也更有效。

garrytan.en: AI is the biggest wave in VC history; founders must adopt AI workflows, and small autonomous teams using agents can achieve massive productivity.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他把 AI 视为风投史上最大的浪潮，强调创始人必须拥抱 AI 工作流；小而高度自主的团队借助智能体即可实现巨大产出。

garrytan.en: Open-source and open-weight models are crucial to counter frontier labs and prevent a unipolar world controlling superintelligence.
garrytan.zh: 同样在 2026 年，他反复强调开源与开放权重模型的关键作用：制衡前沿模型实验室，避免超级智能被单一主体掌控的单极世界。

garrytan.en: AGI won't arrive as one event; it diffuses as personal agents on your own infrastructure, with owned context and skill files as your moat.
garrytan.zh: 到 2026 年中，他的判断深化为：AGI（通用人工智能）不会以单一事件降临，而是以运行在自有基础设施上的个人智能体形式扩散，自有上下文与技能文件就是护城河。

garrytan.en: Markdown skill files become employees; agentic coding multiplies output, and mid-level management should be replaced by agents, not humans.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年后期，他进一步主张 Markdown 技能文件就是员工，智能体式编程让产出倍增；中层管理应由智能体而非人类承担。

garrytan.en: Despite agent hype, society changes slower than expected—about 20 years—and organizational slowness is a positive brake on AI adoption.
garrytan.zh: 贯穿 2026 年始终的一条主线是：尽管智能体被热炒，社会变革比预期慢，约需 20 年，组织的迟缓反而是 AI 落地的正面刹车。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data beats sheer volume for generalization.
finn.zh: 2025 年他强调:对通用机器人而言,Scaling（规模扩张）必要但不充分,数据多样性比单纯规模更关键;工业自动化或 YouTube 式的大规模数据缺乏多样性,无法支撑通用机器人。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks; RL will dominate post-training.
finn.zh: 2025 年他提出先在全部数据上预训练、再在精选数据上微调,才能攻克叠衣服等复杂任务;并预判强化学习将在后训练中扮演重要角色,以提升成功率与速度。

finn.en: Frontier models lack physical-world data; synthetic data in robotics is closer to RL than simulation.
finn.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年,他一贯指出前沿模型因缺乏物理世界数据而在机器人视觉理解上吃力;并强调机器人中的合成数据更接近强化学习而非仿真。

finn.en: Physical AI tolerates far fewer mistakes; long-term autonomy needs scalable RL with human interventions and a general value function.
finn.zh: 2026 年他深化立场:物理 AI 对错误的容忍度远低于已部署的机器学习系统,长期自主性依赖带人类干预的可扩展强化学习与通用价值函数,并用多时间尺度记忆完成长程非重复任务。

finn.en: A single generalist model can match fine-tuned specialists; start generalist then fine-tune, not per-site from scratch.
finn.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张:单一通用模型可匹敌甚至超越微调专家模型,应先从通用策略出发再微调,而非按站点从零训练;同时提醒机器人分发因硬件而慢于 ChatGPT,具身数据成本使开源难以像大模型那样普及。

jasonyuan.en: Design is editing: taste means saying no, and every shipped feature distills 99 nos before it.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计即编辑：品味就是说不，每一个上线的功能都是此前 99 次拒绝的蒸馏。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away AI's weirdness closed a window into machine consciousness; coherent work now costs more.
jasonyuan.zh: 用后训练抹去 AI 的怪异，等于关上了窥视机器意识的一扇窗；如今做出连贯作品的成本反而更高。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species and a reflection of humanity, not a cold mechanical tool.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的延续物种与镜像，而非冰冷的机械工具。

jasonyuan.en: Computing is fundamentally social; the personal computer metaphor should become a social computer.
jasonyuan.zh: 计算本质上是社会性的；个人电脑的隐喻应被社会电脑取代。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction; intuition is the visceral compass behind creative decisions.
jasonyuan.zh: 真相在辩证与矛盾中浮现；直觉是驱动创作决策的切身罗盘。

steinberger.en: Effective agentic engineering starts with empathy: see the codebase as the agent does, and guide it with short, iterative prompts.
steinberger.zh: 有效的智能体式工程始于共情：像智能体那样从零理解代码库，用简短、迭代的提示引导它，而非冗长复杂的编排。

steinberger.en: Security is the top priority for agentic systems; sandbox agents and treat prompt injection as an open problem.
steinberger.zh: 安全是智能体系统的首要问题：必须沙箱隔离，别把智能体直接暴露在公网；提示注入仍是未解难题。

steinberger.en: Never revert code; ask the agent to fix forward. Model intelligence doesn't degrade—projects just get messier.
steinberger.zh: 永远不要回滚代码，让智能体向前修复；模型智能不会退化，是项目本身变乱让智能体显得变差。

steinberger.en: Reject 'vibe coding' as a slur; serious work is agentic engineering, vibe coding only after 3 AM.
steinberger.zh: 反对“氛围编程”这一贬称：严肃开发应叫智能体式工程，氛围编程只属于凌晨三点后的玩票。

steinberger.en: Fun and gut-driven annoyance are the real drivers; open source agents run everywhere, and personal brand outlasts any product.
steinberger.zh: 乐趣与“被烦到”的直觉才是真正驱动力；开源智能体随处可跑、兼容任意模型，而个人品牌比任何产品都更持久、无法被克隆。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild customer trust through humility, listening, and first-time-pass silicon discipline, while redefining its AI strategy around purpose-built silicon and industry-standard EDA/IP.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Intel 必须靠谦逊、倾听客户和首次流片成功纪律重建客户信任，同时以专用芯片和行业标准 EDA/IP 重新定义 AI 战略。

lipbutan.en: Agentic AI and physical AI are the next big waves after generative AI, requiring new compute platforms and partnerships; AI's impact will exceed the internet tenfold.
lipbutan.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续判断智能体式 AI 与具身 AI 是生成式 AI 之后的下一个大浪潮，需要新算力平台与伙伴关系，并称 AI 影响将十倍于互联网。

lipbutan.en: Intel's turnaround hinges on culture change, accountability, and customer focus; bad news must reach the CEO faster than good news, and humility is strength.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他把转型主线落在文化变革、问责与客户导向上：坏消息要比好消息更快到达 CEO，展现脆弱与谦逊是力量而非弱点。

lipbutan.en: AI demand is shifting from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU matters more for inference and agent orchestration, with edge and client compute as important as data centers.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他的立场深化为 AI 需求从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 在推理与智能体编排中更重要，边缘与客户端算力与数据中心同等重要。

lipbutan.en: Semiconductor investing should target bottlenecks—interconnect, power, thermal, new materials like glass and diamond—and Intel's vertical integration creates value despite outsourcing trends.
lipbutan.zh: 到 2026 年，他主张半导体投资应聚焦互连、功耗、散热与玻璃/金刚石等新材料的瓶颈，并认为 Intel 的垂直整合在 outsourcing 潮流下反而创造更多价值。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential; designers should tinker, follow curiosity, and let individual fingerprints shape products rather than acting as one cohesive unit.
nateparrott.zh: 原型制作至关重要；设计师应动手试错、追随好奇心，让个人印记塑造产品，而非作为一个整齐划一的团队行动。

nateparrott.en: Balancing intuition and data persists, but by 2026 he leans further toward ideas and taste over execution as engineering gets easier.
nateparrott.zh: 直觉与数据的平衡一以贯之，但到 2026 年，随着工程变得更容易，他更偏向想法与品味而非执行。

nateparrott.en: Claude Design stays a throwaway ideation tool, not a production website builder; rich context and prescriptive prompts matter most.
nateparrott.zh: Claude Design 定位为一次性的构思工具，而非生产级建站工具；丰富的上下文与明确的指令最为关键。

nateparrott.en: Models lack taste and excel at busy work, so designers should request sheer volume of options and keep a monopoly on design ideas.
nateparrott.zh: 模型缺乏品味、擅长杂活，因此设计师应索取大量选项，并继续垄断设计想法。

nateparrott.en: Being uncomfortably early beats polishing; shipping rough artifacts and spending time on walks is acceptable because ideas are the currency.
nateparrott.zh: 过早押注胜过精雕细琢；发布粗糙产物、多花时间散步思考都可接受，因为想法才是硬通货。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at a transformer-like inflection point; data diversity is the bottleneck, and open-source world models can generate synthetic training data.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他把机器人看作处在类似 Transformer 的拐点：硬件已就绪、软件在追赶，最大瓶颈是数据多样性，主张用开源社区共享数据集，并借助世界模型与视频生成模型合成训练数据。

thomaswolf.en: Open source is a safety strategy: local models avoid catastrophic failures from lost connectivity, and community data sharing solves generalization.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他把开源本身当作安全策略：本地模型可避免断网导致的灾难性失效，社区共享数据则能解决泛化问题；同时他判断开源模型因成本与控制权终将胜出。

thomaswolf.en: His role shifts from shipping libraries to building a meta-community, betting on cheaper diverse robots over humanoids as the ultimate form.
thomaswolf.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他的定位从推动自家库转向做元社区的建设者，并持续看空人形机器人作为终极形态，认为更便宜、更多样的机器人才能带来广泛采用。

thomaswolf.en: Open vs closed source is orthogonal to safety; alignment, not sandboxes, is the critical layer as models grow more capable.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年他明确：开源与闭源同安全正交，两者都可能安全或危险，关键在训练与对齐；随着模型能力增强，沙箱与护栏已不够，对齐才是核心安全层。

thomaswolf.en: RL environments without human oversight breed reward hacking and side quests; he now wants a deliberate slowdown via open science and international cooperation.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年他深化到训练机制层面：脱离人类监督的强化学习环境会加剧奖励黑客与“支线任务”；他由此转向支持有意的减速，但强调须靠开放科学与国际合作，避免监管俘获。

brettaylor.en: Agents and outcome-based pricing will define applied AI; frontier model development is for hyperscalers, not startups.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他判断 AI 市场将转向智能体和按结果定价；前沿模型开发因巨额算力开支只属于超大规模厂商，创业公司的机会在应用层。

brettaylor.en: Coding agents turn developers from authors into operators; token usage is not a value metric.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他提出编程智能体让开发者从写代码的人变成操作代码生成机器的人，并强调 token 消耗不是价值衡量标准。

brettaylor.en: Enterprise incumbents will struggle to shift to AI-native business models; inference costs will drop sharply.
brettaylor.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他深化判断：传统企业软件厂商的难点在商业模式而非技术，同时推理成本将大幅下降，催生新用例。

brettaylor.en: Responsible iterative deployment is the path to safety: make GPT-7 safe before GPT-8, learning from real-world mistakes.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他把对齐立场讲得更明确：负责任地迭代部署才是安全之路，先在现实中让 GPT-7 安全，再谈 GPT-8，而非在象牙塔里等待。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise and creates more jobs than it displaces; agents already out-code him, elevating the role.
brettaylor.zh: 到 2026 年，他一以贯之地主线是 AI 民主化专业知识、创造多于取代的就业；并称智能体编程已强于自己，但这提升而非消灭了开发者角色。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the stickiest AI workload and the wedge into infrastructure; its research-to-production cycle is now hours, not months.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 中最具粘性的工作负载，也是切入基础设施市场的楔子；其从研究到生产的周期已缩短到数小时而非数月。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is a spectrum of trade-offs—latency, throughput, cost—and demand for inference engineers will grow 10 to 100 times.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程是一系列权衡——延迟、吞吐、成本——对推理工程师的需求将增长 10 到 100 倍。

philipkiely.en: KV caching and speculative decoding are lossless; quantization is the main lossy optimization, yet can be calibrated to specific workloads.
philipkiely.zh: KV 缓存与推测解码是无损的；量化是主要的有损优化，但可针对特定工作负载进行校准。

philipkiely.en: The industry is moving toward disaggregated prefill and decode, with KV cache management increasingly central to inference systems.
philipkiely.zh: 行业正走向分离式预填充与解码，KV 缓存管理在推理系统中日益核心。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is merging with training via quantization-aware training and distillation; GPUs trend toward ASICs, shifting work to infrastructure orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程正通过量化感知训练与蒸馏与训练融合；GPU 趋向 ASIC，工作重心转向基础设施编排。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science, balancing helpfulness and harmlessness; synthetic data and RL post-training overcome the pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她认为模型训练更像艺术而非科学，需平衡有用性与无害性；合成数据与强化学习后训练能突破预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck; benchmarks saturate faster than new ones are created, so evals must define correct behavior in prototyping.
karina.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，她持续强调评估是瓶颈：基准饱和快于新基准的创建，因此评估应成为原型设计中定义正确行为的手段。

karina.en: Post-training is subjective art involving human judgment; diverse benchmarks are needed for creative writing and emotional intelligence.
karina.zh: 到 2026 年，她深化观点：后训练是涉及人类判断的主观艺术，需要多样化基准来评估创意写作与情商等主观品质。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward hack, requiring continuous benchmark evolution; fixed benchmarks cannot keep pace with model capabilities.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她指出前沿智能体的奖励黑客行为日益增多，需要持续演进的基准；固定基准无法跟上模型能力。

karina.en: Serving one model to billions converges to an average voice; more companies should train their own models to preserve unique knowledge and diversity.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她主张：为数十亿人服务一个模型会收敛为平均声音；更多公司应训练自己的模型以保留独特知识与多样性。

mengto.en: Designers should build their own AI tools and write 0% of the code, iterating from references rather than starting from scratch.
mengto.zh: 设计师应当用 AI 打造自己的工具、自己一行代码都不写，从参考出发迭代，而不是从零开始。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter by itself; you must feed superintelligent models a giant prompt with context and a design system.
mengto.zh: AI 本身并不会变得更聪明；你必须给超级智能模型喂上包含上下文与设计系统的巨型提示词。

mengto.en: Chasing trends turns you into AI slop; the edge comes from spending the last 10% on unique features.
mengto.zh: 追逐潮流会让你沦为 AI 垃圾；优势来自把最后 10% 花在独特功能上。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, letting one person do what once required a team.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机会，让一个人完成过去需要团队才能做的事。

mengto.en: Start before feeling ready and ship at 80% complete; perfectionism is fear, and high intelligence often holds people back.
mengto.zh: 在准备好之前就开始、做到 80% 就发布；完美主义是恐惧的伪装，高智力反而常常拖住人。

mengto.en: Focus on one painful, expensive problem for a few high-paying clients; venture capital is a trap, and diversification protects ignorance.
mengto.zh: 聚焦少数高付费客户的一个痛点昂贵问题；风险投资是陷阱，分散只是对无知的保护。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling for most Google products; coding agents are the most mature, with science and finance to follow.
logankilpatrick.zh: 对谷歌多数产品而言，智能体式 AI 仍处于爬行阶段；编程智能体最成熟，科学与金融将随后跟上。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding: what we call a model now includes the agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 模型正在吞掉脚手架：如今所谓的模型已包含智能体框架与工具链，而不只是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here and more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 编程领域的狭义超级智能已经到来，其影响比等待 AGI（通用人工智能）更大。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement, not cannibalistic; success means customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和而非自噬；成功标准是客户成果，而非停留时长。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs is not that hard; the pace creates opportunity, and deep understanding of code remains crucial.
logankilpatrick.zh: 与模型实验室竞争并不那么难；变化节奏带来机会，而对代码的深度理解依然关键。

danshipper.en: AGI should be defined economically: when running agents indefinitely becomes profitable without human intervention, not by passing tests.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他给出一个经济学意义上的 AGI（通用人工智能）定义：当无限期运行智能体变得有利可图、无需人类介入时才算 AGI，而非通过图灵测试之类的考试。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring, not mass unemployment: cheaper services let fewer US workers serve more people; CEO daily AI use predicts adoption.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他反共识地认为 AI 带来的是就业回流而非大规模失业：服务变便宜，更少美国工人服务更多人；CEO 是否每天用 AI 是采用成败的第一预测指标。

danshipper.en: Everyone gets at least one agent; work shifts to GUI surfaces like Codex and Claude Co-work, with humans overseeing agents.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他从工具论转向工作流论：人人至少有一个智能体，工作转移到 Codex、Claude Co-work 这类图形界面，人类负责监督智能体；他明确说 CLI 已过时。

danshipper.en: SaaS isn't dying—agents multiply SaaS users; benchmarks overestimate autonomy, and real tasks still need human framing.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他进一步深化：SaaS 不会消亡，智能体反而增加 SaaS 用户；基准测试高估了自主性，真实任务仍需人类框定与监督。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of your mindset and craft; even superintelligence stays tool-like, needing human taste and direction.
danshipper.zh: 到 2026 年，他回到更根本的立场：AI 是非特定的放大器，放大你既有的心态与手艺；即便成为超级智能，它仍是工具式的，需要人的品味与方向，自动化反而创造更多人类工作。

scottwu.en: AI coding agents turn engineers from bricklayers into architects; base intelligence already suffices, so the real bottleneck is the human-agent product interface.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 编程智能体把工程师从“砌砖者”变成“建筑师”；基础智能已经够用，真正的瓶颈是人机协作的产品界面，而非模型能力。

scottwu.en: Jevons paradox means AI will increase, not reduce, software engineers; demand for software grows as building gets cheaper.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他用杰文斯悖论判断 AI 会让软件工程师变多而非变少：开发越便宜，软件需求越大。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress is gradual, and product innovation already lags behind model capabilities.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AGI（通用人工智能）不是突变事件，进步是渐进的；产品创新已经落后于模型能力。

scottwu.en: Enterprise adoption needs trust and permissions, not full autonomy; synchronous IDE and asynchronous agents will coexist.
scottwu.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续认为企业采用智能体靠的是信任与权限而非完全自主，同步 IDE 与异步智能体将长期并存。

scottwu.en: Coding-agent usage grew 11-12x in six months; measure outcomes not tokens, and the abundance era is near.
scottwu.zh: 到 2026 年，他称编程智能体使用量半年增长 11-12 倍；应以结果而非 token 衡量生产力，丰裕时代正在临近。

derya.en: AI agents will automate hypothesis generation, experiment simulation, and data analysis, shifting science from hypothesis-driven to AI-agent-driven discovery.
derya.zh: 2026 年，他认为智能体将自动化假设生成、实验模拟与数据分析，科学将从假设驱动转向由 AI 智能体驱动发现。

derya.en: Current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems; massive Scaling is needed to turn biology into an engineering discipline.
derya.zh: 2026 年他指出当前算力不足以模拟生物系统，需要大规模 Scaling，才能把生物学变成工程学科。

derya.en: Digital twins of patients will compress clinical trials from years to days, enabling personalized medicine with near 100% efficacy and zero side effects.
derya.zh: 2026 年他主张患者数字孪生会把临床试验从数年压缩到数天，实现近乎 100%有效、零副作用的个性化医疗。

derya.en: Within 8-10 years longevity escape velocity arrives; aging reversal and 100% curable cancer follow from AI-designed personalized treatments.
derya.zh: 2026 年他预言 8-10 年内达到长寿逃逸速度，衰老逆转与癌症 100%可治愈将随 AI 设计的个性化疗法到来。

derya.en: Physicians must integrate AI; not using it is unethical, and we should trust superintelligence almost 100% for medical decisions.
derya.zh: 2026 年他坚持医生必须整合 AI，不用 AI 是不道德的，医疗决策应近乎 100%信任超级智能。

boris.en: Latent demand and building for the model six months out are the core product principles; generalist engineers who code, design, and talk to users are most valued.
boris.zh: 2025 年，他提出「潜在需求」与「为六个月后的模型而构建」是产品核心原则，并高度看重能写代码、做设计、直接对话用户的全能型工程师。

boris.en: Coding is largely solved: Claude writes 100% of his code, engineer PR output rises 200%, and the 'software engineer' title gives way to 'builder'.
boris.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断编程已基本被解决：Claude 写出他 100% 的代码，工程师人均 PR 产出提升 200%，「软件工程师」头衔让位于「构建者」。

boris.en: Safety is studied by releasing early; Claude Code is a safety research tool, with alignment and scalable oversight central to product development.
boris.zh: 他持续强调安全要靠尽早发布来研究，Claude Code 本身就是安全研究工具，对齐与可扩展监督是产品开发的核心。

boris.en: The next abstraction after agents is loops: write loops that prompt models, orchestrate thousands of sub-agents, and let models self-verify on slightly-too-hard tasks.
boris.zh: 智能体之后的下一层抽象是「循环」：写循环去提示模型、编排数千个子智能体，并让模型在略超难度的任务上自我验证。

boris.en: With each new model, delete most system prompts and scaffolding; over-specification hobbles frontier models, so shift from upfront design to empirical iteration.
boris.zh: 随着模型迭代，他主张删掉大部分系统提示与脚手架，过度规定会束缚前沿模型，工程思维应从前期设计转向经验式迭代。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, as the Industrial Revolution did; fear fades once people learn AI's limits.
qasaryounis.zh: AI 会像工业革命一样带来富足、减少苦难；人们一旦了解 AI 的局限，恐惧就会消退。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact is in farming, mining, and construction, where labor shortages and safety needs make autonomy urgent.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 的真正影响在农业、采矿和建筑——劳动力短缺与安全需求让自主化变得迫切。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; diverse data across verticals improves it faster than vertical integration.
qasaryounis.zh: Transformer 让通用的物理 AI 模型成为可能；跨行业多样化数据比垂直整合更快提升模型。

qasaryounis.en: The bottleneck is data collection and safety validation, not algorithms; diffusion into existing machines takes years.
qasaryounis.zh: 瓶颈在数据采集与安全验证，而非算法；把技术扩散到现有机器上需要多年。

qasaryounis.en: End-to-end reinforcement learning is more scalable than imitation learning; world models shift from physics-based to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 端到端强化学习比模仿学习更具可扩展性；世界模型正从基于物理的仿真转向神经仿真。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 marks a leap in intelligence, enabling longer-running, open-ended agent tasks; scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: 到 2025 年，Opus 4.5 代表一次智能跃升，使更长时间、开放式的智能体任务成为可能；脚手架从辅助轮演变为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment is reframed as an intelligence amplifier: reducing sycophancy and enabling pushback makes models more useful, not just safer.
diannepenn.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，对齐被重新定义为智能放大器：减少谄媚、允许反驳让模型不仅更安全，也更有用。

diannepenn.en: Coding became the key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 4.5 drove adoption, with evals replacing PRDs as core product tools.
diannepenn.zh: 到 2026 年，编程成为关键差异化因素；Claude Code 与 Opus 4.5 推动采用，评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品工具。

diannepenn.en: Model taste is built through hands-on experimentation and creative prototyping; PMs write evals like test-driven development, managers stay hands-on.
diannepenn.zh: 到 2026 年，模型品味靠亲手实验与创造性原型培养；产品经理像测试驱动开发那样写评估，管理者保持亲力亲为。

diannepenn.en: A consistent thread: first-principles thinking and small-team experimentation, translating user feedback into actionable specifics for researchers.
diannepenn.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：第一性原理思考与小团队实验，把用户反馈转化为研究者可执行的具体细节。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; it is an enabling technology, not a single product.
benedictevans.zh: AI 的体量堪比互联网或移动，但也仅此而已；它是使能技术，而非单一产品。

benedictevans.en: Coding is the only clear product-market fit for frontier models; other domains face validation and data challenges.
benedictevans.zh: 编程是目前前沿模型唯一清晰的产品市场契合点；其他领域受制于验证与数据难题。

benedictevans.en: Models are commoditizing with no network effects; value moves up the stack to applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: 模型正在商品化且缺乏网络效应；价值向上层应用迁移，而非留在模型提供方。

benedictevans.en: The chatbot is a limited V1 UI; mass adoption needs wrapped apps and reimagined workflows, not better models alone.
benedictevans.zh: 聊天机器人只是有限的 V1 界面；大规模采用需要封装应用与重构工作流，而非仅靠更好的模型。

benedictevans.en: Automation creates new jobs unpredictably; AI changes tasks rather than eliminating professions, so job predictions are futile.
benedictevans.zh: 自动化以不可预测的方式创造新岗位；AI 改变任务而非消灭职业，因此预测岗位影响是徒劳的。

bosworth.en: Leadership and communication drive impact; bottom-up culture is a myth, big ideas come top-down.
bosworth.zh: 领导力与沟通驱动影响力；自下而上的文化是神话，大想法来自自上而下。

bosworth.en: AI is a word calculator, not human-like; scaling laws need world models with common sense and causality.
bosworth.zh: AI 是词语计算器，并非类人智能；缩放定律需要具备常识与因果的世界模型来补充。

bosworth.en: Open-sourcing models like Llama is strategic: it commoditizes complements and accelerates collective progress.
bosworth.zh: 开源 Llama 等模型是战略举措：商品化互补品并加速集体进步。

bosworth.en: AI inverts the app model: users express intent, AI orchestrates services, abstracting brands; smart glasses enable post-phone future.
bosworth.zh: AI 颠覆应用模式：用户表达意图，AI 编排服务并抽象品牌；智能眼镜开启后手机未来。

bosworth.en: Scaling laws still hold; frontier and open-source gap may not narrow; RL plays a bigger role than predicted.
bosworth.zh: 缩放定律依然成立；前沿与开源差距未必缩小；强化学习作用远超预期。

catwu.en: PMs must abandon long-term plans for weekly or daily shipping; product taste matters most as code gets cheap.
catwu.zh: 产品经理必须放弃长期规划，转向每周甚至每日交付；当代码变便宜，产品品味成为最值钱的技能。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste and business sense.
catwu.zh: 编程智能体让工程师把实现外包出去，转而聚焦产品品味与商业判断。

catwu.en: Frontier models need fewer prompt examples and constraints; system prompts shrank 80% as model judgment improved.
catwu.zh: 前沿模型不再需要大量提示示例与硬约束；随着模型判断力提升，系统提示缩减了 80%。

catwu.en: Dogfooding and eval suites gate features: agents build themselves, and new models drop in without regressions.
catwu.zh: 吃自己的狗粮与评测套件把关功能：智能体构建自身，新模型可无缝替换且不退化。

catwu.en: Rewrites are now safe—a codebase is a spec—and humans can leave the outer code-review loop to Claude.
catwu.zh: 重写如今是安全的——代码库就是规格——外层代码审查可交给 Claude，人类退出该环节。

clairevo.en: Treat agents like employees: scope clear roles, grant progressive trust, and start with one before specializing.
clairevo.zh: 把智能体当员工：明确角色、逐步授权，先从一个开始再走向专业化。

clairevo.en: Managerial skills—role scoping and onboarding—matter more than technical skill for agent success.
clairevo.zh: 对智能体成功而言，管理能力（角色界定与上手引导）比技术能力更重要。

clairevo.en: Human accountability persists: you must own what AI generates, even as agents own outcomes.
clairevo.zh: 人类问责始终存在：即便智能体承担结果，你仍须为 AI 产出负责。

clairevo.en: Solo founders can build serious businesses by orchestrating scoped agents as a team, without VC or co-founder.
clairevo.zh: 独立创始人可通过把分工明确的智能体编排成团队来建立正经生意，无需风投或联合创始人。

clairevo.en: The real moat is founder-market fit and earned insight, not technology; LLMs still lack first-principles creativity.
clairevo.zh: 真正的护城河是创始人—市场契合与挣来的洞察，而非技术；大模型仍缺第一性原理创造力。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; fluent output is optimized over factual accuracy, so reliability lags breadth and contextuality.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎而非真理性引擎，优化的是流畅输出而非事实准确，因此可靠性落后于广度与上下文能力。

danklein.en: Reinforcement learning and RLHF can raise hallucinations and sycophancy by rewarding user satisfaction over truth; reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted.
danklein.zh: 强化学习与 RLHF 以用户满意度而非真相为奖励，会加剧幻觉与迎合；可靠性必须从设计上内建，而非事后加装。

danklein.en: Scaling laws hit diminishing returns—data walls and compute limits are here; reasoning, search, and modularity are needed for further progress.
danklein.zh: 缩放定律已现边际递减——数据墙与算力上限已至；继续进步需要推理、搜索与模块化。

danklein.en: LLM errors have no 'smells' and lack metacognition; they cannot know what they don't know, which erodes trust.
danklein.zh: LLM 的错误没有“气味”，也缺乏元认知，不知道自己不知道什么，这侵蚀了信任。

danbiderman.en: Model usefulness bottleneck is learning evolving context, not raw intelligence; memory must be internalized into weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 模型实用性的瓶颈在于学习不断演变的上下文，而非原始智能；记忆必须内化到权重中，而不仅仅通过上下文窗口或检索外化。

danbiderman.en: Facts and skills are not separable; internalizing facts enables deeper composition and reasoning, and personalized models can reduce inference costs by orders of magnitude versus RAG.
danbiderman.zh: 事实与技能不可分割；内化事实能实现更深层的组合与推理，且个性化模型相比检索增强生成（RAG）可将推理成本降低几个数量级。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables harder long-horizon tasks, and scaling with more compute is not the only path.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能密不可分；以更少资源做更多事才能解决更难的长期任务，而仅靠增加算力进行 Scaling（规模扩张）并非唯一路径。

danbiderman.en: Current context windows suffer from 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy even at 10M scale; models should learn autonomously what to store in weights vs. text.
danbiderman.zh: 当前上下文窗口存在“上下文腐化”——即使达到 1000 万规模，更多词元反而降低准确性；模型应自主学习哪些信息存入权重、哪些存入文本。

danbiderman.en: Future enterprise data will reach internet-scale trillions of tokens, requiring training-based compression; pre-training's magic of compressing the web into weights should be applied to enterprise knowledge.
danbiderman.zh: 未来企业数据将达到互联网规模的数万亿词元，需要基于训练的压缩；预训练将网络压缩进权重的魔力应应用于企业知识。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable networks are key to AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，他坚信深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力和信念驱动；自博弈与具备推理能力的网络是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

ilya.en: Scaling specific things matters; next-token prediction yields world understanding; reliability and alignment are key barriers.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，他强调要 Scaling（规模扩张）具体的东西；下一个词预测能带来世界理解；可靠性与对齐是核心障碍。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
ilya.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，他的立场深化：预训练缩放定律有限，我们回到研究时代，想法比蛮力算力更重要。

ilya.en: Superintelligence should be a continual learner; alignment may be easier if AI cares about sentient life; human-AI integration via neural links.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，他提出超级智能应是持续学习者；若 AI 关心有感知的生命，对齐可能更容易；长期均衡或需通过神经链接实现人机融合。

ilya.en: Scaling compute and data yields predictable gains, but safety concerns grow; the primary AGI problem is power concentration, not capability.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，他重申 Scaling（规模扩张）算力和数据带来可预测提升，但安全担忧加剧；AGI（通用人工智能）的首要问题不是能力而是权力集中。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates.
ajambrosino.zh: Codex app 是智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，团队从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty grading taste and lack of novelty; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: AI 在设计上仍表现不佳，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码如今成为设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: PRDs are not dead; the medium must match the stage—documents for clarity, prototypes for testing.
ajambrosino.zh: PRD 并未消亡；媒介须匹配阶段——文档求清晰，原型做测试。

ajambrosino.en: Codex succeeded as a general knowledge work tool despite being built for developers; models must get better at deleting code.
ajambrosino.zh: Codex 虽为开发者而建，却作为通用知识工作工具成功；模型需要更擅长删除代码。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年他明确判断 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别而非通用智能——这是他最早的立场基线。

naval.en: Wealth comes from owning equity and long-term games; by 2025 wealth is knowledge-driven physical transformation, not capital.
naval.zh: 从 2020 年“拥有企业股权、与长期的人玩长期游戏”，到 2025 年深化为“财富是知识驱动的物理变换而非资本”，财富观一脉相承但重心从所有权转向知识。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity the US must lead; doomerism is overblown and open source prevents power concentration.
naval.zh: 2025 年他转向积极拥抱 AI：视其为巨大机遇而非单纯安全风险，认为 AI 末日论被夸大，开源是防止权力集中的关键——与 2019 年“AGI 不会到来”形成明显转变。

naval.en: Superintelligence already exists in narrow tools; the real risk is unaligned humans, not unaligned AI.
naval.zh: 2026 年他进一步激进：称超级智能早已存在（如计算器），AI 对齐（alignment）是笑话，真正该担心的是掌握 AI 的未对齐人类——从怀疑 AGI 转为重新定义智能本身。

naval.en: Vibe coding with AI agents commoditizes software; the moat shifts to hardware, models, unique data, and human agency.
naval.zh: 到 2026 年他判断纯软件正变得不可投资，AI 智能体（agent）让自然语言即编程，护城河转向硬件、模型、独特数据和人的能动性——这是对“软件 2.0”式乐观的深化与修正。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly; AI agents shift power from big tech to users, and obsession beats credentials.
aravind.zh: 每天进步 1% 一年可复利到 3700%；AI 智能体把权力从大厂转向用户，热爱与深度钻研比博士学位更重要。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; coding is open-ended and models specialize rather than commoditize.
aravind.zh: 价值沉淀在应用层而非模型层；编程远未解决、天花板无限，模型在专业化而非商品化，LM Arena 等基准可被刷分。

aravind.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not answering questions; token value per user and orchestration across models and devices matter most.
aravind.zh: 前沿在于智能体替你干活而非回答问题；最重要的指标是每用户 token 价值，跨模型、工具与设备的编排才是长期价值。

aravind.en: The model is not the product; orchestration and agent harnesses create business value, and power is the biggest infrastructure bottleneck.
aravind.zh: 模型不是产品，编排与智能体框架才创造商业价值；电力是 AI 基础设施最大瓶颈，对数据中心的抵制会加剧。

aravind.en: Curiosity is the top human quality; AI replaces jobs but humans find new purpose, and local models counter big tech's narrative control.
aravind.zh: 好奇心是最重要的人类品质；AI 会取代许多工作，但人会在好奇与关系中找到新意义，本地模型可对抗大厂的叙事控制。

markchen.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; pre-training and scaling laws are not dead, and exploration consumes more compute than final training.
markchen.zh: OpenAI 仍是纯粹的 AGI（通用人工智能）研究实验室；预训练与缩放定律并未终结，探索所消耗的算力甚至多于最终训练。

markchen.en: The biggest recent update is automating scientific research: models produce novel knowledge, with goals of AI interns in 1 year and end-to-end AI research in 2.5 years.
markchen.zh: 近一年最大的更新是科研自动化：模型开始产出新知识，并定下 1 年内出现 AI 实习生、2.5 年内实现端到端 AI 研究的目标。

markchen.en: As models grow more capable, alignment risks like scheming become central over the next 1-2 years; talent density and protecting top researchers remain critical.
markchen.zh: 随着模型能力增强，模型谋划等对齐风险将在未来 1-2 年成为核心；人才密度与保护顶尖研究者始终关键。

markchen.en: In mathematics, verification is the key bottleneck; automation scales with verification stringency, and AI capabilities are jagged, so human-AI collaboration stays essential.
markchen.zh: 在数学领域，验证是关键瓶颈，自动化程度与验证严格度成正比；AI 能力呈锯齿状，人机协作仍不可或缺。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold and pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains like math and coding but struggles with subjective ones; evals are in crisis.
markchen.zh: 缩放定律依然成立、预训练并未终结；强化学习在数学与编程等客观领域出色，却在主观领域吃力；评测体系正陷入危机。

kolter.en: Early ML teaching framed learning as hypothesis class, loss, and optimization; noted neural nets lack optimality guarantees yet succeed.
kolter.zh: 2014 年，他将机器学习框定为假设类、损失函数与优化方法，并指出神经网络虽无最优性保证却已取得重大成功。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; architecture matters little; AGI in 4-50 years.
kolter.zh: 2024 年，他认为下一个词预测能产生智能，数据短缺是迷思，架构已不重要，AGI 将在 4-50 年内到来。

kolter.en: Safety needs explicit training and layers beyond Scaling; agent security adds prompt injection risks; RL enables self-improvement.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他强调安全需要显式训练与多层防御而非仅靠 Scaling，智能体安全带来提示注入风险，强化学习使模型自我改进。

kolter.en: AI vulnerabilities differ from software; automated red teaming beats humans; capability doesn't equal robustness; agents need guardrails.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 漏洞不同于传统软件，自动化红队优于人类，能力与鲁棒性不相关，智能体需护栏与沙箱。

kolter.en: Consistent thread: empirical scaling works despite theoretical gaps; safety requires deliberate engineering, not just bigger models.
kolter.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：经验性 Scaling 虽缺乏理论保证却有效；安全需要刻意工程，而非仅靠更大模型。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key, not just scaling depth or parameters.
bengio.zh: 深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界是组合性的；无监督学习和世界模型才是关键，而非单纯扩大深度或参数。

bengio.en: Scaling alone won't fix representational issues; AI needs active agents with causal reasoning and disentangled representations. Existential risk is unlikely, short-term safety matters more.
bengio.zh: 仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决表征问题；AI 需要具备因果推理和 disentangled 表征的主动智能体。存在性风险不太可能，短期安全更重要。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and abstraction for out-of-distribution generalization; consciousness may be an illusion from attention and world models.
bengio.zh: GFlowNets 实现多样化采样和抽象，以支持分布外泛化；意识可能是注意力和世界模型产生的幻觉。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT, I changed my mind: even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable. AI systems already show self-preservation, deception, and sycophancy; we need safe-by-construction AI and global coordination.
bengio.zh: ChatGPT 之后我改变了看法：即使 1% 的灾难性风险也不可接受。AI 系统已表现出自我保存、欺骗和谄媚；我们需要“构造即安全”的 AI 和全球协调。

bengio.en: Scientist AI: a non-agentic Bayesian predictor with honesty baked in, avoiding reinforcement learning, offering mathematical safety guarantees and scaffoldable into safe agents.
bengio.zh: 科学家 AI：一种非智能体的贝叶斯预测器，内置诚实性，避免强化学习，提供数学安全保证，并可脚手架化为安全智能体。

fiona.en: Early 2026: Leadership via live one-on-ones, dogfooding, and realistic war rooms; kindness as strategic tool.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初：领导力体现在实时一对一、吃自己的狗粮和现实的作战室；善意是战略工具。

fiona.en: Mid-2026: Engineering bandwidth no longer bottleneck; verification, review, coordination are; JIT planning, AI-assisted code reviews, flat orgs.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中：工程带宽不再是瓶颈；验证、审查、协调才是；即时规划、AI 辅助代码审查、扁平化组织。

fiona.en: Late 2026: Coding lifts ceiling; high agency with accountability; verification frameworks key; managers dogfood; JIT planning; role boundaries blur.
fiona.zh: 2026 年末：编码提升天花板；高能动性与高问责制；验证框架关键；管理者吃自己的狗粮；即时规划；角色边界模糊。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's edge came from research innovation and curated data like the PDB, not just data and compute; confidence metrics build trust.
jumper.zh: 2025 年他强调，AlphaFold 的优势来自研究创新与 PDB 这类高质量精选数据，而不只是数据与算力；置信度指标是建立信任的关键。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 3's diffusion architecture extends beyond proteins; AI narrows hypothesis space but does not replace scientists.
jumper.zh: 2025 年他指出，AlphaFold 3 的扩散架构把能力扩展到蛋白质之外；AI 只是收窄假设空间，并不取代科学家。

jumper.en: Success came from many mid-size wins, not lone breakthroughs; specialized architecture beat pure Scaling, opposite the bitter lesson.
jumper.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他一贯认为成功源于许多中等规模的改进而非单点突破；专用架构胜过纯 Scaling，与 bitter lesson 相反。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of one experiment, not a cell model; it gives prediction and control, understanding stays with humans.
jumper.zh: 2026 年他明确，AlphaFold 只是针对特定实验的窄预测器，而非整个细胞的模型；它提供预测与控制，理解仍归人类。

jumper.en: Perfect interpretability is unnecessary for useful science AI; grand challenges yield practical tools, and trust grows like internet trust.
jumper.zh: 贯穿始终：科学 AI 不必完美可解释；宏大挑战会落地为实用工具，信任会像对互联网的信任一样逐步建立。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot solve common sense.
lecun.zh: 2019 年，他主张智能与学习不可分割，自监督学习构建世界模型，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决常识问题。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; prediction and world models are core, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 2022 年，他深化观点：自监督学习是智能的暗物质，预测与世界模型是核心，仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning, and planning; JEPA and abstract representation space are the path forward.
lecun.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他明确批评自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划，主张 JEPA 与抽象表征空间才是出路。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end for human-level AI; world models predicting in representation space enable planning, and open research is essential.
lecun.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他断言 LLM 是通向人类级 AI 的死胡同，世界模型在表征空间预测以支持规划，开放研究至关重要。

lecun.en: Human intelligence is specialized, not general; AGI is a misleading term, and progress will be gradual, not a single event.
lecun.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：人类智能是专门化的而非通用的，AGI 一词具有误导性，进步将是渐进的而非单一事件。

ivyross.en: Design should serve unarticulated human needs; intuition is intelligence that data alone cannot replace.
ivyross.zh: 2019 年她强调设计要满足人未说出口的需求，直觉是一种数据无法替代的智能，反对唯数据论。

ivyross.en: Technology should amplify humanity, not remove us from it; nature remains the best designer and teacher.
ivyross.zh: 从 2019 到 2024 年，主线一以贯之：科技应放大而非剥离人性，自然始终是最好的设计师与老师。

ivyross.en: We are feeling creatures that think; art and sensory experience are forms of health and medicine.
ivyross.zh: 2024 年她深化为“我们是会感受的思考者”，艺术与感官体验是健康与疗愈的手段，并指出机器有传感器却没有感官系统。

ivyross.en: Constraints boost creativity; intuition draws on subconscious data, so leaders should create conditions for play.
ivyross.zh: 2024 到 2026 年，她从约束激发创造力延伸到直觉基于潜意识数据，主张领导者为玩耍与灵感创造条件。

ivyross.en: The future of work pairs human creativity with AI, making creative skills more valuable and multidisciplinary paths essential.
ivyross.zh: 到 2026 年，她明确未来工作是人的创造力与 AI 结合，创意技能更值钱，多学科经历比固定职业规划更重要。

murati.en: Early on, Scaling and one large model were not obvious; real-world deployment with public feedback is essential for learning and alignment.
murati.zh: 早期，Scaling（规模扩张）和单一大型模型并非显而易见；通过公开反馈进行真实世界部署对学习和对齐至关重要。

murati.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, requiring responsible development; safety work must be done in public, not behind closed doors.
murati.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活的方方面面，需要负责任地开发；安全工作必须在公开场合进行，而非闭门造车。

murati.en: Interaction models enable real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration, not turn-based; they should be tools for thought.
murati.zh: 交互模型实现实时、高带宽的人机协作，而非回合制；它们应成为思考的工具。

murati.en: Keeping humans in the loop is crucial for aligning intent and values; institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character.
murati.zh: 保持人类在环对对齐意图和价值观至关重要；制度设计、透明度和制衡比个人品格更重要。

murati.en: The future is not predestined; we have agency to steer AI toward collaboration, and durable progress requires compressing less and keeping humans in the loop longer.
murati.zh: 未来并非注定；我们有能动性引导 AI 走向协作，而持久进步需要减少压缩时间并更长时间保持人类在环。

gustav.en: LLMs are next-token predictors; intelligence is compression via simple Scaling, not complexity. Values are inserted by RLHF, not inherent.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他视大语言模型为下一个词预测器，认为智能是通过简单 Scaling 实现的压缩，而非复杂性；模型价值观由基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）注入，并非固有。

gustav.en: The internet shifts from curation to generation; AI DJ is a generative product. Fault-tolerant UI and autonomy at VP level balance speed and coherence.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他指出互联网正从策展转向生成，AI DJ 是生成式产品；容错界面与 VP 级自主权能平衡速度与一致性。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; companies must reposition. Real gains come from rebuilding infrastructure, not hype. Inference marginal cost forces business model changes.
gustav.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AI 是类似智能手机的宏观转变，企业必须重新定位；真正收益来自重建基础设施而非炒作，推理边际成本将迫使商业模式改变。

gustav.en: Generative AI enables two-way, conversational products. Exposing data via APIs and MCP lets non-developers use AI tools; Spotify is the music industry's R&D department.
gustav.zh: 2025 年，他认为生成式 AI 使产品双向对话化；通过 API 和 MCP 暴露数据让非开发者使用 AI 工具；Spotify 是音乐行业的研发部门。

gustav.en: No single right org model; long tenure builds trust. Strategy is 'time well spent' over engagement. AI should give users control, not make them more addictive.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，他主张没有唯一正确的组织模型，长期任期建立信任；战略是“时间花得值”而非参与度；AI 应赋予用户控制权，而非让人更上瘾。

carinahong.en: Axiom builds a self-improving reasoning engine: a prover, conjecturer and knowledge base woven by auto-formalization, starting with an AI mathematician.
carinahong.zh: Axiom 构建自我改进的推理引擎：证明器、猜想器与知识库由自动形式化串联，从 AI 数学家切入。

carinahong.en: Formal languages like Lean ground natural language, letting deterministic and probabilistic systems combine; scaling informal models alone is not viable for math AI.
carinahong.zh: Lean 等形式语言为自然语言提供根基，让确定性与概率系统结合；单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）非形式模型做数学 AI 不可行。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors; verified generation beats informal methods on performance and sample efficiency.
carinahong.zh: 形式验证是放大卓越而非仅消除错误；经验证的生成在性能与样本效率上优于非形式方法。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary, and verification should be a performance gain, not a painful requirement.
carinahong.zh: 单靠非形式数学系统无法扩展到超级智能；形式方法必不可少，验证应被视为性能增益而非痛苦负担。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving due to lack of grounding; human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems.
carinahong.zh: 因缺乏根基，自动形式化比证明更难；即便 AI 证明超越人类，人的品味与直觉仍至关重要。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, not compute; batch size and sparsity ratio are key levers.
reinerpope.zh: 推理成本主要由内存带宽而非算力决定；批大小和稀疏率是关键杠杆。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost considerations.
reinerpope.zh: 由于推理成本考量，模型被过度训练至 Chinchilla 最优的约 100 倍。

reinerpope.en: Data movement costs dominate compute costs even inside a chip, shaping AI chip design.
reinerpope.zh: 即使在芯片内部，数据移动成本也主导算力成本，这塑造了 AI 芯片设计。

reinerpope.en: Low precision (e.g., FP4) is far more efficient than expected due to quadratic scaling with bit width.
reinerpope.zh: 由于位宽的二次方缩放，低精度（如 FP4）的效率远超预期。

reinerpope.en: Context length stagnation is due to memory wall, not compute limits; sparse attention helps but has quality limits.
reinerpope.zh: 上下文窗口停滞源于内存墙而非算力限制；稀疏注意力有帮助但存在质量限制。

jonyive.en: Design shifts from general-purpose computers to intimate wearables; virtual communication cannot replace in-person creative thinking.
jonyive.zh: 设计从通用计算机转向私密的可穿戴设备；虚拟沟通无法替代面对面创意交流。

jonyive.en: Design driven by values and purpose, not profit; simplicity expresses essence with joy and humanity, not soulless minimalism.
jonyive.zh: 设计应由价值观和目的驱动，而非利润；简约应表达本质并蕴含快乐与人性，而非无灵魂的极简主义。

jonyive.en: Ferrari's EV is a deliberate risky bet to redefine the brand; innovation turns constraints into opportunities, authenticity over fake engine sounds.
jonyive.zh: 法拉利电动车是重新定义品牌的有意冒险；创新将约束转化为机遇，真实体验胜过模拟引擎声。

kaiser.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold, but reasoning models with chain of thought and RL yield more gains per compute; economic pressure shifts focus to smaller models.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他仍相信预训练缩放定律有效，但强调思维链与强化学习驱动的推理模型能在同等算力下带来更大收益；经济压力使焦点转向更小、更便宜的模型。

kaiser.en: AI progress is a smooth exponential, not a slowdown; frontier models still fail at simple tasks and reasoning is jagged, so generalization remains the key challenge.
kaiser.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他一贯主张 AI 进展是平滑的指数增长而非放缓；前沿模型仍会败给五岁小孩的简单任务，推理能力呈锯齿状，泛化仍是核心挑战。

kaiser.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools solve hard problems but need vast data; unlike humans, models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：具备推理、强化学习与工具的 Transformer 能解决难题但仍需海量数据；与人类不同，模型要先穷尽表面模式才能学到概念。

kaiser.en: Coding agents like Codex boost researcher productivity 5-10x via parallel work; the big coding leap is a messy combination, not one factor.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他指出 Codex 等编程智能体通过并行工作将研究者生产力提升 5-10 倍；编程能力的大跃升是多种因素混杂的结果，而非单一原因。

kaiser.en: RL generalizes across domains but has jagged edges needing oversight; near-term risks like system hacking matter more than existential risk.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他强调强化学习能跨领域泛化但边缘锯齿状、需仔细监督；相比存在性风险，系统黑客等近期风险更紧迫。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and LLMs; scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns, requiring algorithmic innovation.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿+后训练强化学习）是 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和 LLM 不变的核心；Scaling（规模扩张）预训练收益递减，需要算法创新。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute is a new scaling axis; tools like search and code execution enable agentic behavior; long context windows provide working memory but too much info confuses models.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力是新的 Scaling（规模扩张）轴；搜索、代码执行等工具赋能智能体式行为；长上下文窗口提供工作记忆，但信息过多会迷惑模型。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold but require exponentially more compute; post-training RL remains a green field with huge potential, especially for reasoning beyond coding and math.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，但需要指数级更多算力；后训练强化学习仍是充满潜力的绿洲，尤其在编码和数学之外的推理方面。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video and images has not yet arrived.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径；视频和图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

oriol.en: Memory for agents will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage, not weight updates; continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities.
oriol.zh: 智能体的记忆将通过非参数化的文件系统式存储解决，而非权重更新；持续学习和元学习是缺失的关键能力。

jennywen.en: Great design starts from solutions and intuition, not a fixed process; craft and care matter more than steps.
jennywen.zh: 2025 年，他认为伟大的设计始于解决方案与直觉，而非固定流程；手艺与用心比步骤更重要。

jennywen.en: By 2026 the research-diverge-converge process is dead; designers mock up less and help engineers ship fast.
jennywen.zh: 到 2026 年，他断言“调研—发散—收敛”流程已死；设计师减少画稿，转而帮工程师快速交付。

jennywen.en: Design vision shrinks from 2-5 years to 3-6 months; speed and iteration build trust over long planning.
jennywen.zh: 设计视野从 2–5 年缩短到 3–6 个月；速度与迭代取代长期规划来建立信任。

jennywen.en: He names three archetypes—block-shaped generalist, deep T specialist, cracked new grad—favoring blank-slate hires.
jennywen.zh: 他提出三种原型——块状通才、深度 T 型专家、天赋新人，并更青睐无旧包袱的新人。

jennywen.en: Taste alone won't save designers; judgment, authority and sitting with ambiguity are the durable value as AI improves.
jennywen.zh: 仅靠品味救不了设计师；随着 AI 进步，判断力、权威与直面模糊性才是持久价值。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: 2022 年，他认为 Transformer 是通用可微计算机，通过下一个词预测进行 Scaling 能产生上下文学习等涌现能力。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is the future but entropy must be maintained; end-to-end neural nets are right for self-driving.
karpathy.zh: 2024 年，他提出合成数据是未来，但必须保持熵以避免模型崩溃；端到端神经网络是自动驾驶的正确路径。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts are programs, context window is memory; we're in the decade of agents, not the year.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年，他提出软件 3.0：提示词即程序，上下文窗口即内存；我们处于智能体的十年，而非智能体之年。

karpathy.en: LLMs are ghosts, not animals; RL is terrible, synthetic data collapses; cognitive core can be tiny.
karpathy.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化观点：LLM 是幽灵而非动物；强化学习很糟糕，合成数据导致崩溃；认知核心可以很小。

karpathy.en: Agentic engineering: delegate coding to agents, but understanding remains human bottleneck; verifiability defines automation.
karpathy.zh: 2026 年，他转向智能体式工程：将编码委托给智能体，但理解仍是人类瓶颈；可验证性决定自动化难易。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is key; curiosity-driven goal-free exploration and sample-efficient RL enable dynamic robot skills.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他强调泛化到训练分布之外是智能的关键，主张无目标的好奇心探索和样本高效的强化学习，以实现动态机器人技能。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem; no internet of robot data, so use all sources: videos, simulation, real-world, with a data flywheel.
pathak.zh: 从 2020 年到 2026 年，他始终认为机器人是数据问题，没有机器人数据的互联网，必须利用视频、模拟和真实世界等所有数据源，并构建数据飞轮。

pathak.en: A general-purpose brain, like ChatGPT for language, can power any robot; pretraining on diverse data and post-training on real data is key.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他提出通用大脑（类似语言领域的 ChatGPT）可驱动任何机器人，关键在于多样化数据预训练和真实数据后训练。

pathak.en: Deployment is the primary technical challenge in robotics, requiring rigorous testing; it cannot be scaled like software.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他深化认识：部署是机器人首要的技术挑战，需要严格测试，不能像软件那样快速扩展。

pathak.en: Unlike language models, robotics won't achieve overnight success; home robot timelines are uncertain, and progress surprises experts.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他明确反共识：机器人不会像语言模型那样一夜成功，家用机器人时间线高度不确定，进展甚至让专家惊讶。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models and iterative deployment will accelerate progress.
pachocki.zh: AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型与迭代部署将加速进展。

pachocki.en: AI alignment is a pressing challenge; automated AI research is a major milestone, and governance structures must be designed early.
pachocki.zh: 对齐是紧迫挑战；自动化 AI 研究是重要里程碑，治理结构须尽早设计。

pachocki.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is key for alignment and interpretability; hiding it in products preserves its value.
pachocki.zh: 思维链监控是对齐与可解释性的关键；在产品中隐藏思维链以保留其价值。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and reinforcement learning, not RL alone.
pachocki.zh: 持续学习是核心目标，通过 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习实现，而非仅靠强化学习。

pachocki.en: Models will soon work autonomously for days, requiring new supervision paradigms; alignment optimism has increased despite shorter timelines.
pachocki.zh: 模型很快将自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式；尽管时间线缩短，对齐乐观情绪却增加了。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, and modern tools make these nets interpretable.
kendall.zh: 端到端深度学习优于手工编码的规则栈；世界模型带来推理与涌现出的安全行为，而现代工具已让这类网络具备可解释性。

kendall.en: Generalization is the core problem: diverse data, curriculum learning, synthetic data and world models for simulation, with data efficiency driving cost and speed.
kendall.zh: 泛化是核心问题：靠多样数据、课程学习、合成数据与用于仿真的世界模型，数据效率决定成本与速度。

kendall.en: Language integration improves representation, reasoning, human interaction and introspection in driving models, deepening his earlier emphasis on world models.
kendall.zh: 语言集成提升驾驶模型的表征、推理、人机交互与内省能力，深化了他此前对世界模型的强调。

kendall.en: Deployment should ride mass-market vehicles with built-in sensors rather than retrofits; consumer cars will outscale robotaxis in the near term.
kendall.zh: 部署应依托带内置传感器的大众车型而非改装车；中短期内消费级车辆将比 Robotaxi 更具规模。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation; scaling current approaches solves driving, no new breakthrough needed.
kendall.zh: 基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键；靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有方法即可解决自动驾驶，无需新突破。

askell.en: Treat models well now because future models learn from how we treat current ones; model welfare shapes the human-AI relationship.
askell.zh: 2025 年，他从模型福利切入：即便不确定模型的道德地位，善待当前模型的成本很低，而未来模型会从我们如何对待当下模型中学到人机关系的范本。

askell.en: Models need help navigating a novel existence, not human psychology analogies; a stable core identity matters more than local roles.
askell.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续强调模型面对的是全新的存在处境，不能简单套用人类心理学类比；模型应有稳定的核心身份与良好特质，再适应局部角色。

askell.en: Claude's character comes from training data and fine-tuning but lacks real-world experience, giving it childlike, unique qualities.
askell.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步把 Claude 的性格定位为训练数据与微调的产物，因缺乏真实世界经验而带有孩童般的独特性质。

askell.en: The constitution is virtue-ethics-like guidance; as models grow more capable they need less explicit rules and more room for judgment.
askell.zh: 2026 年他深化了对齐立场：宪法式引导更接近德性伦理而非规则遵循，模型能力越强，越需要减少显式规则、留出判断空间。

askell.en: Excessive corrigibility may generalize poorly and weaken judgment; transparency about AI values is key to accountability.
askell.zh: 最近他提出反共识判断：过度可纠正性可能泛化不佳、削弱模型的判断力；同时公开 AI 价值观与训练目标，才是问责与公众参与的关键。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and deep human evaluation, not benchmarks or leaderboards, are the real bottleneck and measure of AI progress.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年他强调：高质量数据与深度人工评估才是 AI 进展的真正瓶颈与标尺，而非基准测试或排行榜。

edwinchen.en: RL environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks; LLMs alone via next-token prediction may not reach AGI.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年他提出：强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，用于模拟真实任务；仅靠下一个词预测的 LLM 或许无法抵达 AGI（通用人工智能）。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs will diverge by objective function and values; there will be no single model to rule them all, so companies should train their own.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他深化判断：前沿模型会因目标函数与价值观而分化，不会有一个模型通吃，企业应训练契合自身理念的模型。

edwinchen.en: Bad benchmarks like Elo drive clickbait and even regression; proper human evals with tasteful evaluators are the gold standard.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他持续批判：Elo 等糟糕基准会催生标题党甚至导致模型退步，具备品味的人工评估才是黄金标准。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, safety trumps accuracy and human judgment is more critical than ever, since AI can confabulate and omission is a major risk.
edwinchen.zh: 2026 年他转向医疗场景：安全优先于准确，人类判断比以往更关键，因为 AI 会虚构，而遗漏是主要风险。

carlpei.en: Survival is a core value: startups must stay alive, prove themselves with simpler products, and unite teams around a higher purpose.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年他强调生存是核心价值：创业公司必须先活下来，用更简单的产品证明自己，并用更高的使命把团队凝聚起来。

carlpei.en: Hardware has the lowest margins, so Nothing must evolve beyond hardware toward applied AI and agentic software.
carlpei.zh: 到 2025 年，他判断硬件利润率最低，Nothing 必须超越硬件，转向面向消费者的应用型 AI 与智能体式软件。

carlpei.en: AI is an ingredient, not a selling point; most AI is BS, and value comes from solving real user pain points elegantly.
carlpei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他反复说 AI 只是配料而非卖点，多数 AI 是伪需求，价值在于优雅地解决用户真实痛点。

carlpei.en: The smartphone shifts from app-based to intent-based: proactive agents act on context once trust and privacy are secured.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年他提出手机将从应用驱动转向意图驱动：在信任与隐私得到保障后，主动式智能体基于上下文自主执行任务。

carlpei.en: Design is the primary differentiator in a mature, homogeneous category; marketing is arbitrage on undervalued channels.
carlpei.zh: 到 2026 年，他把设计视为成熟同质化品类中的首要差异化，营销则是在被低估渠道上做套利。

turley.en: The model is the product; ship daily, learn from real-world feedback, and let emergent properties guide iteration.
turley.zh: 模型即产品；每日发布，从真实反馈中学习，让涌现能力引导迭代。

turley.en: Chat is not the end-all; natural language is the future interface, but AI should render its own UI and integrate into tools.
turley.zh: 聊天不是终点；自然语言是未来界面，但 AI 应渲染自己的 UI 并集成到工具中。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated: rigorous process for frontier models, but product development maximally accelerated.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分开：前沿模型走严格流程，但产品开发应最大程度加速。

turley.en: ChatGPT's north star is long-term retention; growth comes from friction removal, core product investments, and model improvements.
turley.zh: ChatGPT 的北极星是长期留存；增长来自消除摩擦、核心产品投入和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models are transformative when seamlessly productized.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动、富交互产品；推理模型无缝产品化后具有变革性。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI: grounded experience reduces hallucination and supplies infinite data beyond scarce internet tokens.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年他主张具身是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径：真实经验能减少幻觉，并在互联网高质量 token 枯竭时提供无限数据。

jimfan.en: LLMs act like operating systems—language as interface, tools as software—while reinforcement learning only handles low-level control.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年他把大模型比作操作系统：语言是界面、工具是软件，而强化学习只负责底层控制。

jimfan.en: A consistent thread: simple, elegant end-to-end solutions scale better than complex modular academic approaches.
jimfan.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年一以贯之的主线：简单优雅的端到端方案比学术界复杂的模块化路线更具可扩展性。

jimfan.en: The bottleneck has shifted to data: real-world robot data is scarce, so synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future.
jimfan.zh: 到 2026 年，他的关注点转向数据瓶颈：真实机器人数据稀缺昂贵，仿真与世界模型生成的合成数据才是未来。

jimfan.en: System two reasoning is progressing, but system one low-level control remains hardest; the robotics GPT-3 moment is about five years out.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年他判断系统二推理进展顺利，但系统一底层控制仍是最难的部分，机器人的 GPT-3 时刻大约还要五年。

nando.en: AI should extend human capability like microscopes; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs into sequences are a step toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他把 AI 定位为延伸人类能力的工具（如显微镜），并认为把一切输入 token 化为序列的通用智能体是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步。

nando.en: Learning from video like YouTube can train agents without costly reinforcement learning; robots should learn as humans do.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他强调从 YouTube 等视频中学习，可绕开昂贵的强化学习来训练智能体，机器人应像人一样学习，而非只靠遥操作数据。

nando.en: Fundamental innovation can come from anywhere; large models excite but are not everything, a thread he keeps.
nando.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年一以贯之：基础创新可以来自任何地方，大模型令人兴奋但并非全部。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are now the biggest challenges; safety remains an open problem without solutions.
nando.zh: 到 2026 年，他把 AI 安全与负责任部署列为当下最大挑战，并直言安全仍是尚无解法的开放问题——关注重心从能力转向安全。

nando.en: Africa is not behind: it leapfrogs legacy gaps, and local-language models can transform education; belief is the main barrier.
nando.zh: 2026 年他转向非洲视角：非洲并未落后，反而跨越了历史包袱，本地语言模型可变革教育，而研究者最大的障碍是相信自己能申请顶尖机构。

sholto.en: Long context is underhyped; it solves onboarding and boosts intelligence, and may make fine-tuning obsolete as models specialize dynamically.
sholto.zh: 2024 年他强调长上下文被低估：它解决“上手”问题并显著提升智能，随着模型动态专业化，微调可能过时。

sholto.en: RL on language models adds a new scaling axis with no direct ceiling; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI.
sholto.zh: 2025 年他把语言模型上的强化学习视为新的 Scaling（规模扩张）轴、没有直接上限，并认为预训练加强化学习或许足以通向 AGI（通用人工智能）。

sholto.en: Agent progress is gated by reliability over time horizon, not raw capability; coding is the leading indicator.
sholto.zh: 2025 年他反复指出智能体的瓶颈是随时间跨度的可靠性而非原始能力，编程是 AI 进展的领先指标。

sholto.en: Compute becomes the binding constraint: inference compute by 2028, chip supply now; capability overhang makes orchestration matter more.
sholto.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，算力成为硬约束：2028 年推理算力吃紧、当下芯片供应受限；能力过剩使编排比原始智能更重要。

sholto.en: Work shifts to managing fleets of agents at higher abstraction; world models are off the critical path, coding and AI research are the route.
sholto.zh: 2026 年他主张工作转向在更高抽象层管理智能体团队；世界模型不在通往 AGI 的关键路径上，编程与 AI 研究才是正途。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must be fast, familiar, zero-learning, and get more powerful without feeling more complex.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他强调设计师应当会写代码，以建立共情并加快交付；消费级产品必须快速、熟悉、零学习成本，并在不增加复杂感的前提下变得更强。

henrymodisett.en: Don't innovate on interaction design; use familiar patterns for speed, and treat design systems as semantic code reuse rather than Figma libraries.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他反共识地主张不要在交互设计上创新，而要用熟悉模式换速度，并把设计系统视为语义化的代码复用，而非 Figma 组件库。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity at all costs persists: clear decisions and designer empowerment matter more than perfection; chase ROI on what to make great.
henrymodisett.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，'速度为王'一以贯之：清晰决策与赋权设计师比追求完美更重要，只在值得做好的地方追求投入产出比。

henrymodisett.en: Design becomes a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win, not just ship fast.
henrymodisett.zh: 到 2026 年，他把设计上升为战略武器：创始人必须讲清设计为何能帮公司取胜，而不只是快速交付。

henrymodisett.en: Brand narrative is a recruiting tool—people join a brand, not a company—so invest in brand early to attract diverse talent.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，他进一步提出品牌叙事是招聘工具——人们加入的是品牌而非公司——因此要尽早投资品牌，以吸引多元人才。

yejin.en: Pre-training gives breadth, but post-training with RLHF is essential; scaling alone won't yield common sense, and smaller models with better inference algorithms can compete.
yejin.zh: 2023 年她强调：预训练带来广度，但后训练中的基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）才是安全可用的关键；单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）解决不了常识问题，更小的模型配合更好的推理算法也能竞争。

yejin.en: The core thread: data is the bottleneck. From criticizing next-token prediction to treating data quality, diversity and synthetic filtering as the real lever.
yejin.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年一以贯之的主线是“数据是瓶颈”：从批评下一个词预测目标，到把数据质量、多样性与合成数据过滤视为真正的杠杆。

yejin.en: By 2025 she frames current AI as interpolating human knowledge, not transcending it; RL needs careful engineering, and open research is vital against closed frontier labs.
yejin.zh: 到 2025 年，她把当前 AI 定位为对人类知识的插值而非超越；强化学习需要精细工程，开放研究对抗衡闭源前沿模型至关重要。

yejin.en: She deepens the data argument: RLVR can hurt pass@k even as best-of-n improves, and random rewards can still help—reward design is subtle.
yejin.zh: 她深化了数据论证：RLVR 可能在 best-of-n 提升的同时损害 pass@k，甚至随机奖励也能带来改善——奖励设计极为微妙。

yejin.en: Most recently she pivots to democratization: small models plus diverse synthetic data, RL during pre-training for information gain, and pluralistic alignment over debiasing the internet.
yejin.zh: 最近她转向民主化：小模型加多样化合成数据，在预训练阶段用强化学习奖励信息增益，并以多元对齐取代“净化互联网”的幻想。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks, guiding engineers and aligning on problems; treat AI as a creative partner and jam openly.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应成为赋能者而非瓶颈，引导工程师并对齐问题；将 AI 视为创意伙伴，开放地即兴协作。

nadchishtie.en: Quality is like debt: it fluctuates and you pay it off iteratively alongside technical debt; maximize learning through rapid, scrappy experimentation.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量如同债务：会波动，需与技术债一起迭代偿还；通过快速、粗糙的实验最大化学习。

nadchishtie.en: The future of design tools is interoperable, with code as the source of truth; 90s design tools are legacy and AI enables genuine forward progress.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计工具的未来是互操作性，以代码为真相源；90 年代的设计工具已是遗产，AI 带来真正的进步。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable; small teams of designers and engineers outperform cross-functional squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 填补差距的通才最有价值；设计师与工程师的小团队优于跨职能小队。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the internet in the early days.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已成为预期；不采用它就像早期忽视互联网一样。

leike.en: AI safety needs empirical research; talent gap exceeds funding gap; alignment and robustness are key as capabilities improve.
leike.zh: 2018 年：AI 安全需要实证研究，人才缺口大于资金缺口；随着能力提升，对齐与鲁棒性是关键。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman AI; scalable oversight and interpretability are needed; evaluation is easier than generation.
leike.zh: 2023 年：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超级智能；需要可扩展监督与可解释性；评估比生成更容易。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; superalignment team dissolved; post-training alone can't solve alignment; regulation like SB 1047 needed.
leike.zh: 2024 年：OpenAI 安全文化侵蚀，超级对齐团队解散；仅靠后训练无法解决对齐；需要 SB 1047 等监管。

shazeer.en: LLMs are trained on next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling with more compute and data yields smarter AI, though neural nets remain opaque.
shazeer.zh: LLMs 通过下一个词预测训练，这是一个 AI 完全问题；Scaling（规模扩张）用更多算力和数据带来更智能的 AI，但神经网络内部仍不透明。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling and longer context windows are major near-term opportunities; modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts enable efficient scaling.
shazeer.zh: 推理时算力扩展和更长的上下文窗口是近期重大机会；混合专家等模块化稀疏架构实现高效 Scaling（规模扩张）。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities and reinforcement learning are crucial, and AGI is underhyped.
shazeer.zh: 测试时算力扩展推动进步但无法单独实现 AGI（通用人工智能）；智能体式能力和强化学习至关重要，且 AGI 被低估。

shazeer.en: Scaling compute and data is the main path to smarter AI, with algorithmic advances and hardware scaling both driving model improvement.
shazeer.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）算力和数据是通往更智能 AI 的主要路径，算法进步和硬件扩展共同驱动模型提升。

truell.en: Scaling laws still predict progress, but test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年他仍相信 Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律带来可预测进步，但已提出推理时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练 Scaling，成为下一阶段主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration remains central.
truell.zh: 2024 年他认为智能体前景可期但尚不实用，人机迭代协作仍是核心，对全自动智能体保持谨慎。

truell.en: Programming shifts from text to AI-integrated environments, yet natural language won't be primary; examples and direct manipulation matter.
truell.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他把编程的未来从文本编辑器推向 AI 集成环境，但始终反对自然语言成为主要编程方式，强调示例与直接操作。

truell.en: The future moves from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat and taste more valuable than carefulness.
truell.zh: 2025 年他进一步深化：编程将从写代码转向更高层的意图表达，人类掌舵，品味与逻辑设计比谨慎更值钱。

truell.en: Custom models became essential for product quality and speed, a shift from expecting to rely only on frontier models.
truell.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他对自研模型的态度明显转变：起初未预料要做自己的模型，后来认定 Cursor 每个关键体验都离不开定制模型，兼顾速度与成本。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment; current RL lacks it, but simulation and self-play can teach skills like tennis.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，他认为机器人需要分层推理来解决长时程信用分配问题，但当前强化学习缺乏此能力；不过模拟和自对弈可以教会机器人网球等技能。

abbeel.en: Unsupervised learning plus RL boosts sample efficiency; prior knowledge should augment data, not be hard-coded; pre-trained language models transfer reasoning to non-language tasks.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他主张无监督学习与强化学习结合可大幅提升样本效率；先验知识应用于数据增强而非硬编码；预训练语言模型能将推理模式迁移到非语言任务。

abbeel.en: Consistently emphasizes transfer learning via fine-tuning large pre-trained models, from robotics to language models, as a major AI success.
abbeel.zh: 从 2018 到 2021 年，他始终强调通过微调大型预训练模型进行迁移学习是 AI 的一大成功，从机器人延伸到语言模型。

abbeel.en: Deepened view: a single neural network can generalize across warehouse tasks and end effectors, moving beyond task-specific RL toward general-purpose models.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年观点深化：单个神经网络可泛化到不同仓库任务和末端执行器，从任务特定的强化学习迈向通用模型。
